trueAbilities.requirement: An ally within range is the target of a melee attack and/or physical attack.

trueAbilities.name: Earthen Divide
trueAbilities.description:
You create a wall up to 20ft high, 5ft wide and 20ft long in a straight line. Each Segment of the wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus.

Overcharge: You may spend X mana to increase the length by 20 x Xft.

trueAbilities.name: Earthen Guardian
trueAbilities.description: You jump and sidestep towards the attacked ally and the triggering attack resolves against you instead. You automatically take the Block action against this attack.
trueAbilities.requirement: In Steadfast Earth Stance, ally within range is the target of an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Eclipse Breaker
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Heavy attack against all targets in a 15x15ft line.

You must choose the line direction when starting the ability.

trueAbilities.name: Efficient Strike
trueAbilities.description: Make a gathering check and apply it to NP. If this maxes node points, all overflow is converted into lucky points.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must in a gathering session.

trueAbilities.name: Elbow Uppercut
trueAbilities.description: You attack the target for Heavy Damage. Combo: If used after an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword, this ability gains Full Pierce.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Bolt
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. The damage type is chosen at the type of casting and must be that of an element you have mastered. 

On damage, inflict an effect based on the damage type of this attack:

Arcane: The target loses 1 Mana
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X is your Focus x 3.
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X is your Focus, until they take lightning damage.
Lightning: The target becomes Static X, where X equals your Focus x 3.
Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.
Earth: The target becomes afflicted with Sunder X, where X equals your Focus, for the next damage they take.
Wind: You push the target 10ft.
Holy: The target becomes inflicted with Illumination X, where X is your focus / 2.
Dark: The target becomes inflicted with Blinded X, where X is your focus, for their next attack.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Burst
trueAbilities.description: You cause your attack to burst into the target causing them to take additional damage of that element equal to 2d4 + Focus.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can be used after dealing elemental damage that does not contain the Full Pierce or Sure Hit keywords.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Convergence
trueAbilities.description:
You may choose 1 element from Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning or Earth. Until the end of the encounter, you are considered to have mastered that element.

You may swap this element once per turn for 1 Mana.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Dark
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Fire
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Fire

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Frost
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Frost

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Holy
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Lightning
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery: Wind
trueAbilities.description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Wind.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Strike
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).


Arcane: The target loses 1 mana. 
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3. 
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down), until they take Lightning damage.
Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3
Earth/Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.
Wind: You may push the target back 10ft. 
Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power + 5.
Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

trueAbilities.name: Elemental Sweep
trueAbilities.description:
You may make a Light Attack against all enemies within range. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).

Arcane: The target loses 1 mana.
Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3.
Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down), until they take Lightning damage.
Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3. 
Earth/Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.
Wind: You may push the target back 10ft.
Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power+5.
Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

trueAbilities.name: Emergency Maneuvers
trueAbilities.description: When you fail a check when operating an airship, you may use this to reroll the check. You must accept the new result and cannot reroll it again.

trueAbilities.name: Emergency Recall
trueAbilities.description: You give your summon 100 Damage Reduction against the attack. Afterwards, if it is still alive, it is immediately unsummoned.
trueAbilities.requirement: Your summon from Summon Animal is the target of an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Emergency Shield
trueAbilities.description: The target gains temporary HP equal to 7 + Power.

trueAbilities.name: Empower Mana Shield
trueAbilities.description: You spend X mana to add X*8 to the value of your mana shield until the start of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Empty Body
trueAbilities.description: You may reroll the failed saving throw and must accept the new result.
trueAbilities.requirement: You failed a saving throw.

trueAbilities.name: En-dama
trueAbilities.description:
You throw a smoke bomb on the ground within range that blocks line of sight in a 5ft radius (15x15 area total) of where it was thrown. Targets inside or within 5ft of the smoke can only see up to 5ft into or out of the smoke.

If you’re inside of it at the point it's thrown, you may immediately gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.

The smoke lasts until the start of your next turn. When it ends, if you are inside your smoke, you may immediately move up to your speed and you are considered hidden up until you finish that movement. If you end your movement in cover, you keep being Hidden from people you have cover from.

trueAbilities.name: Enduring Warmth
trueAbilities.description: You can emit comforting heat within 30feet that counters the effects of most cold weather. You can activate or deactivate this heat every 1 second.

trueAbilities.name: Energy Drain
trueAbilities.description:
You deal Light full pierce dark damage to a willing ally other than yourself. This damage ignores damage resistance against dark damage (such as from gloom infusion or corvuskite armor), unless that DR is an universal type of DR.

You gain Haste, which gives you 2 AP for the rest of this turn. A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

trueAbilities.name: Envenom Weapon
trueAbilities.description:
You enchant your weapon with a minor venom, making your attacks deal 1 additional full pierce Poison damage when you hit an enemy.

Lasts until the end of the encounter.

trueAbilities.name: Escape Artist
trueAbilities.description: You immediately escape the grapple by twisting and kicking. May be used by spending either AP or RP.
trueAbilities.requirement: You are grappled.

trueAbilities.name: Eternal Mirane Cage
trueAbilities.description: Instead of killing the target, they are reduced to negative their Max HP +1. The target is encased in Magical Ice for 10 years, rooted on the location and cannot be moved.  The Ice never melts despite temperature and can only be dispelled by Higher Order Magic (such as a Divine Arms), or by you. The Spell effect ends if you die. You can extend the duration of the Frost by 10 years for every 2 mana spent.
trueAbilities.requirement: Use when an ally attack would kill a target and target is not an ally.

trueAbilities.name: Eternal Vigil
trueAbilities.description: While in statue mode and sleeping, you make perception checks as if you were awake.

trueAbilities.name: Evasive Maneuver
trueAbilities.description:
You Sidestep 5ft in any direction.

When used on your turn, you may spend 1 mana and 0 AP on this ability instead.

trueAbilities.name: Evil Eye of Death
trueAbilities.description:
You open your Mystic Eye, focus it on a single target and they instantly die.

Upkeep: 3 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack against a new target.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must be a grunt.

trueAbilities.name: Evil Eye of Fear
trueAbilities.description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict fear on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range must make a save against your potency or become Shaken until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

trueAbilities.name: Evil Eye of Lethargy
trueAbilities.description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict lethargy on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range become Slowed until the start of your next turn, unless they spent 1 RP to resist the effect.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

trueAbilities.name: Excavation Crash
trueAbilities.description: Choose one adjacent location 5ft from the target. The target may immediately use a move action for 0 RP to move there if they wish, you cannot make an attack of opportunity during Excavation Crash. If the target does not move to the location, make a heavy attack against them.

trueAbilities.name: Execute Heretic
trueAbilities.description: You deal damage to the target equal to their max HP.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must be downed.

trueAbilities.name: Expert Farmer
trueAbilities.description:
Greater Infuse Qi
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from rare to mystic and adding 20 to its difficulty.

Bountiful Harvest II
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants 4 times that amount and you add 10 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

trueAbilities.name: Expertise Study (Armorsmithing)
trueAbilities.description:
You gain 5 Expertise Points in 2 different armorsmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in Heavy Armor or Greatshields.

In addition, you always gain the expertise bonus when crafting an armor for yourself. An armor crafted this way cannot be worn by other creatures and is effectively valued at 0 clim.

trueAbilities.name: Expertise Study (Artificing)
trueAbilities.description: You gain 5 expertise points in 3 different Artificing crafts.  You also gain one basic weapon proficiency or one specialized weapon proficiency of your choice.

trueAbilities.name: Expertise Study (Blacksmithing)
trueAbilities.description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different blacksmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in one smithing melee weapon of your choice. You may select specialized weapons with this.

trueAbilities.name: Expertise Study (Carpentry)
trueAbilities.description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different carpentry crafts.  You also gain wielding proficiency in one carpentry weapon of your choice or artifice chainsaws.

trueAbilities.name: Explosive Advance
trueAbilities.description: You immediately activate Horse Step Acceleration and it becomes active for the entire first round of combat.  Immediately make up to 1 AP of movement actions.

trueAbilities.name: Explosive Ward
trueAbilities.description: A ward that can be placed on a door or medium-sized container of some sort. If other than you knowingly tries to open the door or container in any way (whether normal opening, attacking it etc), the ward triggers creating a loud noise and dealing Heavy Fire Damage to all creatures in a 10ft radius around the container. All items inside the container (if any) also take this damage. Once triggered, the bounded field vanishes. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. You may at the time of casting choose a number of people equal to your Focus that can also open the container or door without triggering the ward. If not triggered, Explosive Ward lasts until you remove it. For each Explosive Ward you maintain your maximum mana is reduced by 2. This is considered a tier 2 ward.

trueAbilities.name: Exposing Edge
trueAbilities.description:
You sharpen your blades, enhancing the effects of your debuffs.

Upkeep: You may spend 1 AP or 1 mana to continue the effect.

trueAbilities.name: Exposing Stab
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you may use your Devastating Strike against the target until the end of your turn as if the target had 0 RP.

trueAbilities.name: Extending Spear
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light Attack against all targets in a line up to the range.
trueAbilities.requirement: Polearm only.

trueAbilities.name: Extra Arms
trueAbilities.description: Your next interact with object costs 1 less AP.

trueAbilities.name: Fading Counter
trueAbilities.description: When the enemy attacks you in melee, they instead attack an illusionary clone, missing you. You may then immediately attack the enemy with a basic Light Melee Attack. You may then move up to 5ft in any direction and this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Carapace
trueAbilities.description:
One of your Fluttering Blades returns to you and interferes with the attack. You may take the dodge or block action against the attack. 

Your Fluttering Blade needs LoS to you or the target it is assisting.

This cancels Fluttering Blade on that weapon.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 RP or 1 mana to make it assist an ally within 30ft of the sword instead.
trueAbilities.requirement: Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade Active. You or an ally is the target of an attack and your chosen Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade is not part of that attack.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Devouring Locust
trueAbilities.description: Your Fluttering Blade moves in a straight line up to 60ft. Make a light attack that affects every target that the Blade passes through.
trueAbilities.requirement: An active Fluttering Blade within range.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Gadfly
trueAbilities.description:
Sends a Fluttering Blade to harass the target within 90ft of you, making a light attack against them. 

The Fluttering Blade then occupies the same space as the target and follows them throughout all movement, including teleportation. 

The Gadfly then Challenges the target. You can upgrade this attack of opportunity to a heavy attack for 1 RP or 1 Mana.
trueAbilities.requirement: Fluttering Blade Active

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Megasoma
trueAbilities.description:
You direct a Heavy Spin Fluttering Blade at a target within 30ft of you, making a Heavy attack and cancelling Fluttering Blade on that weapon afterwards.

The chosen Blade must have Line of Sight to the chosen target.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can only be used with Heavy Spin Fluttering Blades that have been active for at least 1 whole round.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Oak Stance
trueAbilities.description:
You enter Fae Knight Style: Oak Stance. Weapons with Fluttering Blade can move up to 20ft as a part of an attack. 

Your Fluttering Blade does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Petal Swirl Flash
trueAbilities.description:
You teleport to an enemy within range.

Make a melee Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise attack (2 AP) against that enemy. Afterwards, you regain the use of your Faerie Flash allowing you to use it again this encounter.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Second Plague
trueAbilities.description:
Your Fluttering Blade returns to your hand in the fastest possible path (typically a straight line), it avoids obstacles in the most direct way possible. Make a light attack that affects every target that the blade passes through. Deactivates Fluttering Blade when it returns to you.

Combo: If used after Devouring Locust, reduce the AP cost by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: An active Fluttering Blade within range and in Oak Stance. Must have a hand available to catch the weapon.

trueAbilities.name: Fae Knight Style: Willow Stance
trueAbilities.description:
You enter Fae Knight Style: Willow Stance. Increasing your Fluttering Blade Limit to 2. Shields can be used as Fluttering Blades while in Willow Stance. 

For 2 mana, all Fluttering Blades created in Willow Stance this turn can be enhanced with Heavy Spin, allowing them to be used for some Willow abilities but they no longer gain your agility as extra evasion.  Heavy Spin blades also deal 5d6 upgraded heavy attack damage, even if they were originally a one-handed weapon.

When directing your Heavy Spin blades to move, you may direct two blades for 1 AP instead of just 1 blade.

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Eyes: Calling
trueAbilities.description: You activate your Faerie Eyes, charming a target to move their Speed towards you. If your Focus is higher than the target’s the target moves up to its speed towards you. The target immediately stops their movement if they are going to take damage from further movement. Against Grunts, this attack always hits regardless of Focus, costs 0 mana, and the target will continue to move even if it will take damage.

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Flash
trueAbilities.description: You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see. Can only be used once per encounter.

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Flash II
trueAbilities.description:
You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see.

If you gain an effect that would let you regain the use of Faerie Flash and you use Faerie Flash II that turn, instead reduce the mana cost of this ability by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Light Eyes:  Empty
trueAbilities.description:
You lock eyes with an enemy, casting an illusion onto the target’s mind. Name an ability that the target had previously used in the current encounter. The target forgets the target ability, being unable to use it completely while the Illusion is in effect. This ability cannot target Secret Arts, Climax Arts or Esoteric Arts. Only one target may be under the effect of this illusion at a time. If the target is non-heroic and under the effect of Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person, instead the target immediately is rendered insane permanently. An insane target takes no further combat actions.

If used on a grunt under the effects of Hold Person, they do not need to meet the normal requirements for this ability.

Does not work against Boss type enemies. Some abilities such as those granted by items, passives or racial abilities (such as flight) also cannot be removed by this ability (GM's discretion).
trueAbilities.requirement: Enemy has used the target ability

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Golden Illusion
trueAbilities.description:
You copy the target’s ability that was forgotten and add it to your abilities until the end of the encounter. You must still fulfill all requirements to use this skill. This ability is generated from illusions and gains the keyword, Illusion. You can only have one Golden Illusion ability at a time.

If the target stops being affected by Empty, you lose your Golden Illusion ability.
trueAbilities.requirement: A target is affected by Faerie Light Eyes: Empty.

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person
trueAbilities.description: You gaze into the target’s eyes and stun them for 1 turn, reducing their AP and RP to 0. While stunned, the target can also not take any actions.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must be a grunt and have eyes.

trueAbilities.name: Faerie Light Eyes: Time Dilation
trueAbilities.description: Flooding your eyes with magic, you cast a self Illusion causes time slow down. You use the Dodge action with a Dodge bonus equal to 2X.
trueAbilities.requirement: You are the target of a single-target attack.

trueAbilities.name: Faithful Shield
trueAbilities.description:
You may use Shelter once at 0 RP cost if the target is your Soulmate. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Overcharge: You may spend 4 AP on this ability to instead gain 2 free uses of Shelter.

These free uses ignore the normal limitation of using an ability only once per turn.

trueAbilities.name: Fan of Knives
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light Attack against all enemies in range. This is considered a Ranged Weapon Attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
trueAbilities.requirement: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

trueAbilities.name: Farming Basics
trueAbilities.description:
Spiritual Ground
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You infuse the land with your spiritual energy, creating up to 10 plots of land suitable for farming. These plots of lands can grow food and herbs at an accelerated rate and allow the planting of tier 1 rare herbs.

All plots of land must be filled with seeds before they begin growing. 

After creating a spiritual ground, you may immediately use Sow Seeds in it for 0 IP.

You can only have 1 spiritual ground at the same time.

Sow Seeds
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You may plant seeds in plots of land. You may plant 1 set of seeds in each plot of land you can work.

Harvest
Cost: 1 Interlude Point
Description: 
You harvest the planted seeds or take care of the plants not ready to be harvested yet. Do a crafting session. Your crafting score is the total value of seeds you can harvest or take care of.

If your crafting score is not high enough to harvest or take care of all seeds you planted, you must give up on some of the seeds. Starting from the seed with the highest difficulty, you drop seeds until your total crafting score matches or exceeds the total difficulty of the seeds.

Infuse Qi
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from common to rare and adding 10 to its difficulty.

Bountiful Harvest
Keywords: Rapid
Description: 
You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants double that amount and you add 5 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

trueAbilities.name: Fast Dimensional Equip
trueAbilities.description:
You summon an item from your dimensional armory into your hand. You can also send a held weapon (not wielded or carried by another creature) under your full control to your Dimensional Armory and swap it with another from your Dimensional Armory.  

You may use 1 RP to activate this ability. If you do, the Mana cost is reduced by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: You have a Dimension Armory active.

trueAbilities.name: Fast Hands
trueAbilities.description: You reduce the AP cost of your next Interact with object action this turn by 1.

trueAbilities.name: Fast Runner
trueAbilities.description: Your base movement speed is 25ft instead of 20ft.

trueAbilities.name: Feeding Frenzy
trueAbilities.description:
You may use this after reducing an enemy’s hit points to 0 or less.

You may immediately use your Vampire Bite ability for 0 RP against the enemy you downed.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be under the effects of Blood Frenzy.

trueAbilities.name: Feign Death
trueAbilities.description: The first time you enter the Downed state in an encounter, you may use Play Dead as a reaction for 0 RP. In addition, you gain a +10 bonus to playing dead.

trueAbilities.name: Feigned Retreat
trueAbilities.description:
All allies in a 15x15ft square within range may Sidestep up to their speed towards you. 

If they successfully left an enemy’s melee range and are not in an enemy’s melee range after moving, then the first time an enemy enters their melee range before the start of their next turn, they may make an Attack of Opportunity against that enemy.

trueAbilities.name: Feint
trueAbilities.description: You target an enemy. If the target is a Grunt or you have higher Agility than the target, then they cannot make an attack of opportunity against you until the start of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Feinting Stab
trueAbilities.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If they react to it in any way, you may cancel your attack on them and instead make it against a different enemy in range. Any RP spent by the first target is not refunded.
trueAbilities.requirement: At least two enemies within range.

trueAbilities.name: Felling Strike
trueAbilities.description: Make a heavy attack against a target enemy that is no larger than large size category. On damage, sidestep to any unoccupied space next to the target, of the same elevation as the target, and knockback the target 10ft.
trueAbilities.requirement: Axe, Chainsaw and Giant Scissors Only

trueAbilities.name: Field Medic
trueAbilities.description: Medical and Surgery kits (including any upgraded versions) you carry have their burden reduced by 1, down to a minimum of 0.

trueAbilities.name: Fiery Rebirth
trueAbilities.description:
You regain HP until you are at 1 HP, stand up from prone and deal Light full pierce fire damage to all enemies within 5ft of you.

All buffs and debuffs on you are removed.

After using this ability, the mortal wound condition is removed from you and you cannot use Fiery Rebirth again for the rest of the arc.
trueAbilities.requirement: You’ve suffered a mortal wound.

trueAbilities.name: Fight or Flight
trueAbilities.description:
Fight: You immediately gain 2 AP that can be used on basic abilities, but lose 1 RP.

Flight: You immediately gain 1 RP, but recover 2 less AP on your next turn.

You regain the use of this ability after the Encounter Conclusion phase.

trueAbilities.name: Fireball
trueAbilities.description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area.

trueAbilities.name: Fireball Barrage
trueAbilities.description: You hurl three Fireballs at three separate 15x15ft areas, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in each area. Each unit can only be attacked once per use of this ability, even if hit by multiple fireballs.

trueAbilities.name: Fireball II
trueAbilities.description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area. On damage, they become Burning X where X equals your Power x 3 Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to increase the size of the area. Every mana spent increases the size by 5ft.

trueAbilities.name: First Aid
trueAbilities.description:
You grant an ally First Aid X, where X is the damage they took.

When an ally has First Aid applied by you, you may spend 1 AP while within 5ft of them to remove all First Aid and heal the target for your Focus up to the First Aid value.
trueAbilities.requirement: An ally is damaged

trueAbilities.name: First Response
trueAbilities.description: If you have a Medical Kit, you may use your encounter conclusion to give the Second Wind encounter conclusion effect to someone else. You heal for an additional 1d6 (+3 from your Demonblood Regeneration if you have it) when doing this.

trueAbilities.name: Fissure
trueAbilities.description:
You slam the ground and create a 15ft wide fissure up to the target point. Those at the edges of the spell’s range may spend 1 RP to Sidestep 5ft out of the effect. All caught in the effect fall down 20ft into the fissure and take falling damage as normal.

The spell requires natural ground to be below the touching surface to function. It may work on the bottom floor of a house, but will fail if used higher up or in some dungeons.
trueAbilities.requirement: Special

trueAbilities.name: Flame Infusion
trueAbilities.description: You surround a willing target in searing flames, changing their typing to Fire II. As a Fire II type, they take half damage from Fire and Frost Damage or attacks with the Fire or Frost keywords unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Water Damage or attacks with the Water keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain immunity to Burning. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

trueAbilities.name: Flame Shield
trueAbilities.description: The attacker immediately takes Light Fire Damage.
trueAbilities.requirement: An ally took damage from a melee attack.

trueAbilities.name: Flame Wall
trueAbilities.description: You create a wall of Fire that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 30ft high. This wall must be a straight line. Anyone passing through the wall or starting their turn in it takes Heavy Fire Damage. The wall lasts for 10 minutes or until canceled. Those in the wall when it is casted, may spend 1 RP to sidestep out of the wall. A person can only take this damage once per round.

trueAbilities.name: Flame Weapon
trueAbilities.description: You touch one willing ally’s or your own weapon and enchant it with Fire. Until the end of the encounter, the weapon deals Fire Damage and grants a +1 Power Enchantment.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Bomb
trueAbilities.description: You throw a Flash Bomb at a point within range that explodes in an 25x25 area centered on that point. All targets within the area must save against Potency or become Dazed.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Cut
trueAbilities.description: You draw your katana and attack with such Speed it becomes impossible to perceive, making a Heavy Attack against the target, after which you resheathe the weapon. This ability does not break the Iai state.
trueAbilities.requirement: Katana only, must be in Iai state.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Star Style Secret Art: Twin Nova Pursuit
trueAbilities.description: You teleport to the target and then knock them 25ft in any horizontal direction.  You then teleport in a straight line to them again and make a Heavy attack.  If the attack is responded to with any RP action, knock them straight back 25ft again, teleport in a straight line to them and make another Heavy attack.
trueAbilities.requirement: Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Star Style: Photon Line
trueAbilities.description:
You sidestep exactly 25ft in a straight line in any direction and can move over gaps of terrain as long as you end on solid ground. You make a Light attack against all targets that are in your path.  If only one target is in your path, make a Heavy attack instead.

If you were flying at least 10ft above the ground when using this ability, you do not need to end on solid ground.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can move 25ft in a straight line. Light sword, longsword, katana, dueling weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Star Style: Starlight Crescent Reversal
trueAbilities.description: You take advantage of the slow windup of the enemy’s attack, countering with a Light attack of your own. You may still Dodge or Block the triggering attack after this counter.
trueAbilities.requirement: You are targeted by a heavy attack. Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Flash Star Style: Thunderbolt Slash
trueAbilities.description:
You slash the target in a thunderbolt pattern, making a 3-hit attack.  Make 3 separate Light attacks against the target.  

Combo: If used immediately after Flash Star Style: Photon Line, mana cost reduced by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: Light sword, Longsword, Katana, dueling weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Flight
trueAbilities.description:
You gain controlled Flight up to your speed. If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of your next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

When you end your turn within 5ft of the ground, Flight ends.

trueAbilities.name: Flower Squirt
trueAbilities.description: You press your flower and make a Light attack against the target that deals Water damage. On damage they are Soaked for X, where X equals your Focus until the next time they take Lightning damage.

trueAbilities.name: Flowing Kick
trueAbilities.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Combo: If used after an unarmed attack misses, reduce the AP cost of this by 1.

trueAbilities.name: Flowing Wind Strike
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Light attack against the target that deals additional damage equal to double your Windflow stacks. Afterwards, you lose all Windflow stacks.

Afterwards, you may Sidestep 5ft though this movement does not give a Windflow stack.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must have moved at least 10ft before using this.

trueAbilities.name: Flushing Shot
trueAbilities.description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may choose to sidestep out of cover from your attack to automatically avoid the attack. Otherwise, the attack gains Sure Hit.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must be in Low or High cover.

trueAbilities.name: Fluttering Blade
trueAbilities.description:
You infuse a melee weapon within ability range that you are familiar with (belongs to you and was originally in your combat inventory at the start of the encounter, or has been in your dimensional storage for at least a day) with magic, causing it to float into the air that listens to your directions. You can have one Fluttering Blade at a time. 

When a Fluttering Blade weapon takes damage, it drops to the ground and becomes inert.

Fluttering Blade has a base evasion of 7+Your Agility.

You can direct your Fluttering Blade to move, it has a base movement speed of 30ft and does not provoke attacks of opportunity by moving. You can also direct your Fluttering Blade to attack within its attack range. It can make basic Heavy, Light and Precise attacks as well as special Fae Knight attacks. The blade is counted as its own entity for the purpose of attacking, though it uses your stats.

You need at least 1 hand free to direct a blade.

trueAbilities.name: Fly
trueAbilities.description: You or the creature you touch gains Fly, which gives them controlled Flight, Hover and their movement speed is doubled while flying until the end of the encounter. If they take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, their altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce their altitude to the point where they touch the ground, they become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of their next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from an flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

trueAbilities.name: Flyby Attack
trueAbilities.description: You sidestep up to your speed. At any point during this movement, you may spend 1 AP to make a Light attack with a weapon or spend 2 AP to make a Heavy attack with a weapon. After this attack, you may change the direction in which you spend the rest of your movement.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be mounted on a flying mount.

trueAbilities.name: Flying Kick
trueAbilities.description: You may Sidestep next to the target within range and make a Light Attack against it. You gain Flight for this movement. Combo: Your Strike of Still Water has its AP cost reduced by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must have hit a target with Ki Blast in the previous action.

trueAbilities.name: Focused Detonation
trueAbilities.description: Make a gathering check against either Node or Lucky points. If this strike would max it out, you may instead leave it at 1 away from completion and you gain +1 Strike Dice
trueAbilities.requirement: Must in a gathering session.

trueAbilities.name: Focused Power
trueAbilities.description: When you’re about to take the extra damage from Inexorable Shadow Stance, you may choose to maximize the damage instead of rolling. Affects both the self damage and the damage you deal with it.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in Inexorable Shadow Stance.

trueAbilities.name: Forager's Eye
trueAbilities.description:
Initiate a sight and sound based search for hidden plants, fungi, creatures or living enemy units in a 30x30 area within range.  You become automatically aware of the targeted species of plants, fungi or creatures or you can choose to be aware of all hostile enemy units.  You must have line of sight to the target in order to spot them.  After revealing the target your Lifebeat Sense gains (if used immediately after):

Combo:  If used after Forager's Eye, the AP and mana cost of this is reduced by 1 and the target's location is known to you and your allies until the end of your next turn. This removes Hiding from them.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can see or hear the target category.

trueAbilities.name: Forest Walker
trueAbilities.description: You ignore difficult terrain created by vines, foliage and similar natural phenomena.

trueAbilities.name: Foretell
trueAbilities.description:
You receive a vision of the near future. Roll a d20 and store that number. When you or your allies are going to roll that dice type, you can instead replace it with your dice roll, you then lose your Foretell dice. You can only have one Foretell dice at a time, casting Foretell again overwrites the previous dice. Foretel dice last until the end of your next turn.

After rolling, you may spend 1 mana to reroll the dice once. After doing this, you can't do so again for this use of the ability.

trueAbilities.name: Forged Knowledge
trueAbilities.description: Using your knowledge of weapons, you infuse the strongest point of your weapon with mana and then strike at the perfect angle dealing maximum weapon damage.  Maximize one damage dice for the attack.
trueAbilities.requirement: Attack must be made with a weapon you crafted.

trueAbilities.name: Forged Knowledge II
trueAbilities.description: Your bond with the weapon allows you to infuse it with mana at a crucial point. Use when determining attack damage, maximize all weapon dice for that attack.
trueAbilities.requirement: You or an ally attacked with a weapon or item you crafted.

trueAbilities.name: Forgemaster Core Crafting
trueAbilities.description:
Blacksmith’s Modification B
Cost: X Crafting Points
Description: 
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

trueAbilities.name: Forked Lightning
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light Attack against two different targets who can be no further than 20ft apart, dealing Lightning Damage and on damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus x 2.

trueAbilities.name: Forward Momentum
trueAbilities.description: Until the start of your next turn, on damage of every melee attack you make, you may push the target back 5ft. You must then move 5ft towards that target (if possible to do safely) without provoking attacks of opportunity. This only works with attacks that target a single enemy.

trueAbilities.name: Four Field System
trueAbilities.description: Make a crafting check. Afterwards, whenever you use an ability for crafting that you haven’t used before in this crafting session, it gains a +2 bonus to the crafting points it gives.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in a crafting session and costs 1 crafting dice.

trueAbilities.name: Four Point Strike
trueAbilities.description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm II. 

Combo: If used after Two Point Strike or against a target afflicted with Wave Palm I, the mana cost is reduced by 2 and the AP cost by 1. If the target is afflicted with Wave Palm I, you apply Wave Palm III instead of Wave Palm II.

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next action that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.

trueAbilities.name: Freerunner
trueAbilities.description: You do not incur difficult terrain penalties in Forest, Cities or Ruins.

trueAbilities.name: Frost Coffin
trueAbilities.description: You cast a Spell that flash freezes a target Grunt, killing them instantly and creates a two Glacial Wall cube stack at their location. These cubes have HP equal to 15 + Focus. These structures can function as cover. Ice wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

trueAbilities.name: Frost Driver
trueAbilities.description:
You send ice spikes along the ground towards a single target, making a Heavy attack that deals Frost Damage. This cannot hit a target higher than 5ft above the ground. On hit, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.  If the target is already Slowed, they instead become Rooted, making them unable to move until the end of their next turn.

Combo: When used after Icicle Nail or White Thunder hits, reduce the mana cost to 0.

trueAbilities.name: Full Bloom
trueAbilities.description: You consume Regrowth on the target, removing the buff and healing the target immediately for twice its regular value.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target ally must have Regrowth on them.

trueAbilities.name: Full Dimensional Equip
trueAbilities.description: You swap your armor, cloak and weapons currently wielded with a dimensional set.  The weapon and armor you had equipped as you used to this ability become a Dimensional Set, allowing you to switch back to it.
trueAbilities.requirement: You have a Dimensional Armory active.

trueAbilities.name: Full Power Swing
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy attack that does double heavy damage.
trueAbilities.requirement: Two-handed weapons only.

trueAbilities.name: G. Shift
trueAbilities.description:
You take 11 true damage, then choose to either lose 1 RP or reduce your AP by 1 for your first turn. 

You temporarily mutate your body, granting an effect similar to one of the following Alchemy Elixirs:  Rabbit, Reaper, Shark, Tunnel, Bull, Bear. This effect does not stack with their corresponding Elixir Effect. This effect cannot be dispelled and lasts until the end of the encounter.

trueAbilities.name: Gale-Wind Aura
trueAbilities.description: You project a Gale-Wind Aura around yourself that increases the movement speed of allies (excluding yourself) within 60ft of you by 20ft. An ally that starts their movement in the Aura, keeps the Speed increase for that move even if they leave the aura. Upkeep: You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the aura fades.

trueAbilities.name: Gene Activation
trueAbilities.description:
You transmute yourself, consuming a gene. You transform,  granting yourself a single chimera racial ability that corresponds with the gene. 

You are transformed until the end of your next turn. Doing this consumes the gene from your DNA. You can deactivate the transformation for 0 RP.

You cannot obtain and use abilities that require an IP or EP to use through this ability.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must have the required Gene in your gene inventory.

trueAbilities.name: Genjutsu Kai
trueAbilities.description: You focus your internal energies and dispel any Illusions affecting you or an ally within 5ft of you.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target is under the effects of an Illusion.

trueAbilities.name: Glacial Bastion
trueAbilities.description:
You encase yourself in a Glacial Wall that fills your space until the start of your next turn, making you untargetable for attacks during the duration. This Glacial Wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus, any remaining damage is transferred to you (mitigated by your armor).  While encased, you can cast White Thunder on your encased Ice for 1 RP which removes Glacial Bastion. Other than White Thunder, you cannot take any other actions while under the effect of Glacial Bastion.   

This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

trueAbilities.name: Glacial Wall
trueAbilities.description: You create 4 * X connected ice structures that are 5ft x 5ft cubes that last for up to 24 hours. These cubes have HP equal to 20 + Focus. These structures can function as low cover. Ice Wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

trueAbilities.name: Gleaming Cut
trueAbilities.description: You attack with blades of pure light making a light attack against the target, dealing Holy(Light) damage. On damage, inflict Illumination  X where X equals your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Glide
trueAbilities.description: You slow down your falling speed to 15ft per round and you are able to move horizontally as if normally moving. If you hit the ground while Glide is active, you do not take any falling damage and this effect ends.

trueAbilities.name: Glittershards
trueAbilities.description: Numerous sparkling arcane crystals swarm the area and block line of sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Glittershards can only see up to 5ft into or out of Glittershards. Glittershards lasts for up to 10 minutes and you can only have 1 Glittershards active at a time. You can end this effect for 0 AP on your turn.

trueAbilities.name: Gloom Infusion
trueAbilities.description:
You surround a willing target in gloom and shadow, changing their typing to Dark II. As a Dark II type, they take half damage from Dark Damage or attacks with the Dark keywords, unless the attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Holy Damage or attacks with the Holy keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain 60 feet Darkvision and a +4 bonus to saves against mind affecting effects. 

The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

trueAbilities.name: Gnome Claws
trueAbilities.description: You burrow into natural earth ground, granting Burrow, making you move underground at your normal speed.  While you are not attacking, you gain a +10/+20 bonus to your dodge except against other burrowed creatures. Using any action except movement or basic defenses cancels Gnome Claws.  Canceling Gnome Claws with a melee attack grants a +2 Accuracy Bonus to the attack.

trueAbilities.name: God's Blessing
trueAbilities.description: The AP cost of True Divine Release I is lowered by 4 and the mana cost upkeep is lowered to 0.

trueAbilities.name: Good Fortune
trueAbilities.description:
You always seem to find money in inexplicable ways.

At the end of an Interlude phase, you gain 500 Clim per Interlude Point spent during the phase.

trueAbilities.name: Goring Charge
trueAbilities.description:
You lower your head and charge in a direction with your horns. You move X times your speed in a straight line. If you move at least 15 feet, you make a Heavy attack against the first target in your path. They may sidestep this attack for 1 RP.

If a target sidesteps your attack, you continue charging for your maximum distance or until you hit an object. If you charge into another creature, you make a Heavy attack against them as well and the process continues. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures that sidestepped your attack for this movement.

If the object you charge into is destroyable, the GM may also ask you to make a Heavy attack against it.

These attacks are considered unarmed attacks that you are proficient in, even if you normally wouldn't be. It does not benefit from any sort of gauntlet bonuses.

trueAbilities.name: Graceful Landing
trueAbilities.description: You gain Graceful Landing until the start of your next turn, treating all fall distance as 50ft lower.

trueAbilities.name: Graceful Service
trueAbilities.description:
You assist a target character, giving them 1 additional encounter conclusion action.

This uses up your own encounter conclusion action.

trueAbilities.name: Grand Theft Horse
trueAbilities.description:
The target must make a save against your Potency or be immediately dismounted and knocked prone next to their mount. You may then spend 0 RP to immediately mount it.

Does not work against creatures that are considered a mount by themselves such as Dullahans or Centaurs.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must be mounted.

trueAbilities.name: Gravitational Ki
trueAbilities.description: You target one unit and either push them away from you 5ft or pull them towards you 5ft. Cannot move a creature or object that’s bigger than 5ft and automatically fails against enemy heroic creatures.

trueAbilities.name: Gravitational Push
trueAbilities.description: You push the target 20ft or pull it 20ft towards you.

trueAbilities.name: Gravity Crush
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Physical (Crushing) damage.

trueAbilities.name: Greater Imbue Weapon
trueAbilities.description: You may enchant your weapon as though you had used Imbue Weapon, but it also gains a +1 Power bonus in addition to the normal benefits. If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

trueAbilities.name: Grindstone Echo
trueAbilities.description: You make a crafting check. You may choose the dice result from a previous check this crafting session and use that as your roll value.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in a crafting session.

trueAbilities.name: Grudge
trueAbilities.description: You curse the attacker and make a Light attack that deals Dark(Curse) damage against them.
trueAbilities.requirement: An enemy hits you with an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Guard Dog
trueAbilities.description:
You redirect the attack towards you instead of your ally and may take the Block action against it for 0 RP.

You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. Your Block action works against both of these attacks.
trueAbilities.requirement: An ally within range is the target of an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Guided Aim
trueAbilities.description: You gain a bonus to your next accuracy roll equal to the mana spent on this ability. If the attack is a Precise Attack, the bonus gained is doubled.

trueAbilities.name: Half Restore
trueAbilities.description: You heal your summoned animal for 11 + Power x 2 HP. It also removes 1 negative effect from it. If the amount healed exceeds the target’s maximum HP, any extra HP is converted into temporary HP.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can only target your summoned animal.

trueAbilities.name: Hammer and Nail
trueAbilities.description: Make a light attack against the target with Sure Hit and Full Pierce.
trueAbilities.requirement: An ally dealt damage to a target that didn't take a defense action.

trueAbilities.name: Hardening Fist
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you gain Hardening Fist, which gives +2 guard and +8 Block, but lose 4 evasion (including dodge) until the start of your next turn.

Combo: If used after Steadfast Earth Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

trueAbilities.name: Harvest Moon
trueAbilities.description:
You call down a harvest moon over the area that shines in a 60ft radius around yourself. 

All allies in range may spend 2 Mana at the start of their turn to heal for 15 HP.

All enemies starting their turn in its range must make a Save against your potency or become slowed.

You may end this ability early by choosing to make a 0 AP heavy attack against an enemy slowed by this ability. This attack must be made with a Scythe. On killing blow of that attack, you recover 1 mana.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

trueAbilities.name: Haste
trueAbilities.description: Grants the target Haste, granting them 2 AP for the rest of this turn.  A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

trueAbilities.name: Haunting Bark
trueAbilities.description: You bark at an enemy forcing them to make a Save or become shaken until the end of their next turn. The third time in a combat you use this against the same target, they also take Light Full Pierce Lightning damage in addition to the shaken effect if they fail their save.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in Dog Form.

trueAbilities.name: Headless
trueAbilities.description: Critical hits rolled against you do not gain Half Pierce and do not automatically deal maximum damage.

trueAbilities.name: Headwind
trueAbilities.description:
You project an aura around you that hinders the movements of enemies. 

All enemies that start their movement within 30ft of you become slowed. If an enemy takes a Move basic action outside of your zone and spends more than 1 AP, they are still slowed after calculating each individual AP spent on the move.

Upkeep: 1 AP

trueAbilities.name: Healing Seed
trueAbilities.description:
The next time Regrowth naturally triggers on that ally and heals them, it also removes all stacks of a debuff on the target.

If the debuff has Persist, you pay this additional mana cost when the Regrowth triggers and not upon using this ability.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target ally must have Regrowth on them.

trueAbilities.name: Hearthlight
trueAbilities.description: You can glow, emitting a comforting light within 30 feet. You can activate or deactivate this light every 1 second.

trueAbilities.name: Heavenfall Descent
trueAbilities.description:
You crash to the ground without taking falling damage and make a Light attack against all enemies within 5ft of you.

May target a point on the floor as long as it’s within 20ft of you horizontally.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be airborne and between 20ft and 120ft above the ground.

trueAbilities.name: Heavenly Lightning Stance
trueAbilities.description:
You enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance, a stance that lets you move with the unpredictability of the heavens. For your first movement of your turn, you may pass through enemies and your movement becomes a Sidestep.

If you have mastered Sky Talon Style, entering this stance also counts as your Wind Stance.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or make an attack with anything other than a melee attack or an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword.

trueAbilities.name: Heavy Trample
trueAbilities.description: When using Trample, you may use your Toughness for the damage roll instead of your mount’s power.

trueAbilities.name: Helix Siphon
trueAbilities.description:
When you make a melee attack against an enemy that is a Chimera, you copy some of their DNA, granting you a gene for any ability of their race.

This gene is temporary and only lasts until the end of combat. Alternatively, you can touch an ally Chimera or downed enemy and copy a single gene.
trueAbilities.requirement: Melee attack deals damage against a known Chimera.

trueAbilities.name: Hibernate
trueAbilities.description: When you take the rest IP action, the temporary HP gained is doubled. When you rest during the night as a rest action, you recover an additional toughness HP.

trueAbilities.name: Hidden Wards
trueAbilities.description: You may choose to hide your Bounded Fields when casting them by making a Stealth check. The casted ward uses the result of your Stealth check. Hidden Bounded Fields cannot be seen with Sense Magic without a successful perception or insight check.

trueAbilities.name: Hide in bush
trueAbilities.description: You take the Hide action and are considered to be in cover for the purposes of remaining stealthed. This lasts until you take any action or speak.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in natural terrain.

trueAbilities.name: Hide in Shadows
trueAbilities.description:
You jump into a target’s shadow. If you were hidden before using this ability, you remain hidden inside the shadow. Else, the target or any other enemy may attack the shadow as if they were attacking you. If you take damage, you are forced out. While you’re inside the shadow, you travel with the target when it moves, including if it teleports, but cannot take actions other than exiting it.

You may exit the shadow willingly for 0 RP. When you exit it, if you were hidden, your next basic attack that turn against the target whose shadow you were hiding in gains Full Pierce.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be day.

trueAbilities.name: High Power Shell
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft.

You are pushed back 5ft away from the target regardless of whether it hits or not.
trueAbilities.requirement: Cannon only.

trueAbilities.name: Highly Sensitive to Magic
trueAbilities.description: You may enter the Aetherie class without meeting its requirements and the cost for doing so is reduced by 100 exp.

trueAbilities.name: Hit & Run
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you may move up to your speed.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be mounted.

trueAbilities.name: Hold the line
trueAbilities.description: Your next Block action costs 0 RP. Until the start of your next turn, unless you use the Dodge action, you become Immovable.

trueAbilities.name: Holy Declaration
trueAbilities.description: You take the Block action against the attack. Afterwards, you challenge all enemies within 5ft of you until the start of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Holy Light
trueAbilities.description: You Heal the target for 8 + Power

trueAbilities.name: Holy Orders
trueAbilities.description:
You target an enemy unit within range, causing the target to become your Holy Order until the start of your next turn. 

While active, only your Holy Order may be chosen as the target for any offensive ability, or must be included as a target to use an offensive action. 

If you make an attack of opportunity against your Holy Order, or if they move away from you while in your melee range, you can Sidestep up to twice your Speed towards them for 0 RP after their movement finishes.

Can only be used on your turn before you use an offensive action.

trueAbilities.name: Holy Shield
trueAbilities.description:
Your gain Holy Shield, which gives your next Block action gains a +2 guard bonus (not doubled again). If you reduce the damage you take with your next Block action to 0, you gain 3 temporary HP.

Overcharge: You may spend up to 3 additional AP on this ability. Each extra AP spent increases the Guard bonus and temporary HP gained by 3.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be using a shield.

trueAbilities.name: HONK!
trueAbilities.description: You place a clown nose on the target and honk it. The target must succeed at a Save or become challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Hopping Zombie
trueAbilities.description: You gain +20 to any checks that involve jumping.

trueAbilities.name: Horse Body
trueAbilities.description:
You may carry an ally on your back without lowering your movement speed and your Burden is increased by 2. However, you are considered a large creature. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you and many humanoid buildings will struggle to accommodate you. You also suffer a -10 penalty on most finesse athletics checks, as well as a -10 penalty on climbing and swimming checks.

Picking up an ally takes 1 AP and they cannot take AP actions while on your back. You or they may spend 1 AP to dismount and act like normal.

trueAbilities.name: Horse Step Acceleration
trueAbilities.description: You gain Horse Step Acceleration until the start of your next turn, which increases movement speed by 30.  All of your movement is now Line Movement (You may only move in a straight line when making a movement action).

trueAbilities.name: Horse Whistle
trueAbilities.description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may sidestep up to its speed towards you and it gains Trample (as per the ability, if you have it) for this movement. If this movement moves your mount onto your square, you may mount it for 0 RP. If you were prone and mount your mount, you are no longer prone.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must NOT be mounted.

trueAbilities.name: Hover
trueAbilities.description: You can passively hover up to 5ft above the ground. While hovering, you are not an eligible target for abilities that require a target to be flying or airborne unless you'd meet those conditions normally.

trueAbilities.name: Hug tight
trueAbilities.description: You deal Light Damage to the target.
trueAbilities.requirement: Enemy Unit Affected By “Just A Hug”.

trueAbilities.name: Human Adaptability
trueAbilities.description:
As an errand action, you may refund an ability and choose to learn another ability. You cannot pick an ability that makes you ineligible for any of your prerequisites. Your new ability must cost the same as your unlearned one, or you must pay additional normal EXP to make up for the cost difference. If you choose to unlearn a class and learn a new one with this ability, you must spend IP for that new class as normal. Any previous IP spent on learning the class you unlearn is NOT refunded.

If you choose to refund primary stats, secondary stats or skill points and then level up the class again, you must put those points back in the same things you originally put them in.

Does not work on breakthroughs.

trueAbilities.name: Hunting Wolf
trueAbilities.description: You may move towards the target as if you had spent X AP on movement. Your movement speed is doubled for this movement.
trueAbilities.requirement: The target enemy is below half HP.

trueAbilities.name: Hydromancer
trueAbilities.description: You start with the Hydromancer class unlocked and at level 2.

trueAbilities.name: Hyphal Force
trueAbilities.description:
Your spore symbiote surges the host’s muscles with temporary power. When the host of Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack, increase the damage by your Light Attack Damage. The extra damage dealt is Earth Damage.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
trueAbilities.requirement: The host of your Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack.

trueAbilities.name: Iai Strike
trueAbilities.description: You draw your weapon and attack with lightning speed, making a Heavy Attack. You lose the Sheathed state afterwards.
trueAbilities.requirement: Katana only. Must be in the Iai state.

trueAbilities.name: Icicle Nail
trueAbilities.description: You fire a shard of ice at a target unit, making a Light Attack that deals Frost Damage. On hit, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Ignite
trueAbilities.description: You may use this as a reaction after you deal Fire Damage to an enemy to set them on fire, causing them to become Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3. Overcharge: You may target additional enemies with this ability if you hit them with the same ability or attack. You may pay 1 mana per target beyond the first to also affect them with this ability.

trueAbilities.name: Illuminating Flash
trueAbilities.description: You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area centered on the point must make a save against your Potency or be inflicted with Illumination X where X  your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn. They also become Blinded 5 for their next attack.

trueAbilities.name: Imaginary Consumables
trueAbilities.description:
You ‘draw’ an imaginary basic consumable alchemy item or minor item that can cost no more than 100c per mana spent on this ability and no more than 500c total. 

This consumable works like regular consumables would, but only you can use it, normal people can’t see it and it doesn’t work with abilities that require you to use real consumables like counter-potion.

Any items created with this ability only last until the end of the encounter, or for 5 minutes outside of one.

trueAbilities.name: Imaginary Weapon
trueAbilities.description:
You ‘draw’ an imaginary weapon or shield in which you are proficient. 

This weapon works exactly like a normal weapon would, but only you can wield it and normal people can't see it.

trueAbilities.name: Imbue Weapon
trueAbilities.description:
You enchant your melee weapon with an element you mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

trueAbilities.name: Improvised Defense
trueAbilities.description: You grab a nearby item and use it as cover against the triggering attack while taking the Dodge or Block action. The type of item used determines whether it is light, heavy or full cover.
trueAbilities.requirement: You become the target of an attack.

trueAbilities.name: In The Zone
trueAbilities.description: You add a crafting check to the item. This craft gains a +X bonus where X is equal to the amount of crafting dice spent this session.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

trueAbilities.name: Incendiary Ray
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Fire damage against all targets in a 10ft wide line up to the range. On damage, inflict Burning X where X is your Power x 3.

trueAbilities.name: Increased Reach
trueAbilities.description: The range of the next Spell you cast is doubled. Only works on Spells that have a range listed in ft.

trueAbilities.name: Independent Action
trueAbilities.description:
Your animal summoned through the Summon Animal ability gains the ability to act independently. It acts at initiative 0, though you may still control its action. A summon with Independent Action starts with 2 AP and 1 RP and may use those as normal. If they have an ability that costs mana, then you still have to pay that mana cost.

While it is under the effects of Independent Action, you cannot command your summon through the use of your own AP.

A summon targeted by this ability takes up 2 slots towards the summon limit. If this would put you past your limit, you cannot use this ability.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can only target your summoned animal.

trueAbilities.name: Inexorable Shadow Stance
trueAbilities.description:
You enter a stance that enhances your attacks at the cost of your own life. Whenever you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, you may deal Light or Heavy true damage to yourself to increase the damage of the attack by the same amount. This may be done after reactions to the attack have been declared, though an enemy may still choose to react to it again or differently afterwards.

If used with an attack that hits more than 1 target, this extra damage only applies to one of the damage rolls.

You may do this effect twice per round. If an enemy dodges to make you miss and refund the effect, it still counts as one of your uses. When enhanced, these attacks gain the Augment keyword.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

trueAbilities.name: Infernal Bastion
trueAbilities.description: You surround yourself with flames and take the Block action against the attack. If you reduce damage of this attack to 0, inflict Burning X on the target where X is your focus x 3.
trueAbilities.requirement: You are targeted by a melee attack.

trueAbilities.name: Inspired Finish
trueAbilities.description: Make a crafting check. The dice is upgraded to 3d10 and you still add your crafting bonus to this. The crafting immediately ends after using this ability and you may not spend Crafting Points to add artisan bonuses, alloys or similar things.
trueAbilities.requirement: This is your last crafting dice. Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

trueAbilities.name: Inspiring Song
trueAbilities.description:
All allies within range (including yourself) may add 1d4 to a single roll they make until the start of your next turn. They may choose to add this after seeing the roll.

Upkeep: At the start of your next turn and every turn thereafter, you may spend 1 AP to continue this performance, granting all allies within range the benefit once again.

trueAbilities.name: Instinct
trueAbilities.description:
The first time per encounter that you are attacked by a Stealth attack, that attack does not gain the Trick Attack benefit. If you become the target of an attack while you're surprised, you may still react to it and any special properties of an attack that require you to be unaware of the attack (such as Killshot) do not apply to it. 

In addition, when you are about to take an action that leads to grave harm or death (example: The enemy has an instant death ability), you can receive a premonition from the DM.

trueAbilities.name: Intercept
trueAbilities.description:
You move towards an ally, Sidestepping them 5ft in a direction of their choice and occupying their square. The triggering attack is made against you and you automatically take the Block action against it.

Mounted move rules apply to your movement for this action.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be mounted and an ally is the target of an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Into the Fray
trueAbilities.description: You may move up to twice your movement speed. You must end this movement in range to make a melee attack against an enemy. Can only be used on your turn.

trueAbilities.name: Invisible Wall
trueAbilities.description: You create an invisible 5ft wide and high wall within range. It gives Low Cover, but it counts as High Cover against the first ranged attacks the wall gives cover from.

trueAbilities.name: Judgement Shot
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Light attack against the target.

Afterwards, an ally other than you within 30ft of you may make a Light attack against the target. They may spend 1 RP to make this a Heavy or Precise attack instead.

trueAbilities.name: Jump
trueAbilities.description: You leap up to 30ft into the air and then Sidestep up to twice your Speed. You may use Skydive at any point during this movement.

trueAbilities.name: Jump Back
trueAbilities.description: You Jump Back to your previous location. This movement does not provoke any attacks of opportunity.
trueAbilities.requirement: Previous action had the jump keyword.

trueAbilities.name: Just a hug
trueAbilities.description:
You coil and grapple a non-heroic enemy that is not larger than you, rooting both of you and rendering the target incapable of any attacks.  You automatically guard against any attacks made towards the target as if using Block.  You can also use this on a willing ally target.

The target may spend 1 Ap or 1 RP to attempt to escape, granting them escape power equal to their power.  Further escape attempts continue to add escape power.  When the escape power is equal to 8, then the target successfully escapes.  You may end this effect at any time for 0 RP.

trueAbilities.name: Justice Blade
trueAbilities.description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

trueAbilities.name: Kage Bunshin: Kyomei
trueAbilities.description: Your clone assists in the preparation of your next Ninjutsu, reducing the AP cost of it by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: You must have a Bunshin clone active and within range.

trueAbilities.name: Kage Shuriken no Jutsu
trueAbilities.description: You attack by throwing two weapons at the target, one hidden in the shadow of the other. Both of these are considered Light Attacks. If you fail your Accuracy roll on the first one, the second gains Sure Hit.
trueAbilities.requirement: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Kawarimi no Jutsu
trueAbilities.description: The triggering attack automatically misses and you may move up to your Speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. You then gain the Hiding state from anyone you have cover or concealment from.
trueAbilities.requirement: Targeted by an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Blast
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane damage.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Blast II
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane Damage.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Burst
trueAbilities.description:
Your attack deals an extra X damage.

If used with a basic attack or double punch, deal 2X extra damage instead up to a maximum of +10 damage. Only affects 1 damage roll even if an attack makes multiple attacks.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can be used after damaging a single opponent with an Unarmed Strike attack.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Circulation
trueAbilities.description: You cycle the Ki inside your body and purge it from negative energy. You remove Bleeding, Shaken, Unbalanced or any Poison effect from yourself.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Recovery
trueAbilities.description: You spend your Encounter Conclusion action to regain 2 mana.

trueAbilities.name: Ki Sense
trueAbilities.description: You send out your Ki and become aware of any creatures without presence concealment within 40ft of you, giving you a rough idea of their location. This does not remove Hiding from them, but their attacks against you do not gain Trick Attack or any other stealth or surprise bonuses until the start of your next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Kibaku Fuda Shuriken
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy Attack by throwing a weapon with an explosive tag attached at a target. Regardless of whether it hits, the target and others within 5ft of the target must then make a save against Potency or take Light Fire Damage.
trueAbilities.requirement: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Killshot
trueAbilities.description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Damage instead.

If fired in the first round of combat while all enemies are unaware of you, the target has to spend an additional RP to react to your attack. This stacks with the Trick Attack keyword, but is ineffective against abilities that negate surprise or stealth attacks such as Instinct.
trueAbilities.requirement: Sniper Rifles only

trueAbilities.name: Kiri-tsuke
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state.
trueAbilities.requirement: Katana only

trueAbilities.name: Kiri-tsuke II
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state. Combo: If used after Iai Strike, the AP cost is reduced by 1.
trueAbilities.requirement: Katana only.

trueAbilities.name: Kneel
trueAbilities.description: The target must make a Save or fall prone.

trueAbilities.name: Knockback Shot
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is pushed back 20ft.

trueAbilities.name: Knockout Punch
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage if the enemy is a Grunt, they immediately drop to 0 HP and fall unconscious.

trueAbilities.name: Kugeki-zan
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against the target.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target must have 0 RP remaining.

trueAbilities.name: Last Rites
trueAbilities.description: You deal +1 damage to undead creatures. This is increased to a +2 bonus on Heavy attacks.

trueAbilities.name: Last Stand
trueAbilities.description: Until the start of your next turn, you may use the Block action for 0 RP and you gain additional Guard equal to the mana spent on this ability. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again in this encounter.

trueAbilities.name: Lay on Hands
trueAbilities.description: You Heal the target for 4 + Power. Overcharge: You may spend an additional mana to remove a negative effect from the target. Injuries and Mortal Wounds cannot be removed with this.

trueAbilities.name: Leashing
trueAbilities.description: You teleport your summoned animal to an empty square within 5ft of you.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can only target your summoned animal.

trueAbilities.name: Leg Sweep
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target falls Prone.

trueAbilities.name: Lengthened Incantation
trueAbilities.description:
You lengthen the time it takes to cast your next Spell to empower it. You may add 2 AP to the cost of your next spell with the Spell gaining additional Light Damage on it. If you cannot pay this AP cost this turn, the Spell also gains the Setup keyword.

If the Spell has multiple attack rolls or different damage rolls, this bonus only applies to one of them.

However, if the spell is a Scattering AoE spell then the bonus damage applies to all targets of that spell. If that Scattering spell hits a target more than once it only applies to one damage roll. If the spell lasts for multiple turns, it only applies to the initial casting.

trueAbilities.name: Lifebeat Sense
trueAbilities.description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of the target until the end of combat.  (The DM should enable health bars for the unit, or you can ask for an approximate percentage). In addition, the target is afflicted by Expose 1, reducing the target’s crit threshold by 1. (20 to crit becomes 19.) Expose is removed once the target is critically hit (regardless of if they defend or not)

trueAbilities.name: Lifesense
trueAbilities.description:
You know the direction your Soulmate is in and if you’re within 300 feet of them, you know their exact location.

You also know their current HP, Mana and RP.

trueAbilities.name: Light Work
trueAbilities.description: Only usable as the first crafting action. All material costs are doubled and all produced items are doubled. You may only use basic crafting actions for the rest of the craft. Make a crafting attempt.
trueAbilities.requirement: Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

trueAbilities.name: Light's Care
trueAbilities.description: At the end of combat you may use 1 Encounter Conclusion action to heal a single target for 11 + Power x 2 and grant them First Aid. First Aid: The target can expend an Encounter Conclusion Action to prevent one injury to themself.

trueAbilities.name: Lightning Lariat
trueAbilities.description:
You gather lightning energy and move up to your speed in a direct line and make a Heavy attack against a target. If you moved more than 60ft before making the attack, your attack gains the Trick Attack keyword.

Overcharge: You may spend X mana to move an additional 2 x X times your speed. 

Combo: If used after Heavenly Lightning Stance or Secret Art: Lightning Release, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

trueAbilities.name: Lightning Rod
