trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, inflicts the enemy with Toxic, making them take 1d6 full pierce Poison damage at the start of their turn until they spend 2 AP to remove the poison effect.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be made with a melee weapon or with a Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

trueAbilities.name: Verdant Instinct
trueAbilities.description: Make a gathering check and apply it to NP. After rolling, roll two more dice that will be used as your next 2 strike dice values. You may reorder them or replace one with a 5.
trueAbilities.requirement: Must be in a gathering session.

trueAbilities.name: Victory or Death
trueAbilities.description:
All melee weapon attacks that you make this turn deal maximum damage on hit. All weapon attacks made against you until the start of your next turn also deal maximum damage on hit.

Once used, this cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.
trueAbilities.requirement: In rage stance.

trueAbilities.name: VIP Protection
trueAbilities.description:
You change the target of the attack to you instead of your VIP.

This attack automatically hits you and you may not use the Dodge and Block or similar reactions against it. 

The re-directed attack is treated as having most the requirements met as if it was still targeting the original target, including effects that are conditional such as Full Pierce on a downed target, and you are considered to be in the original target's spot for the purposes of range of the attack you're re-directing. 

GM's may rule some conditional effects are based on you rather than the original target, such as attacks with effects based on race.

Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity and cannot be used against an attack that's already redirected.
trueAbilities.requirement: Your VIP is within 5ft of you and is the target of an attack that does not target you as well.

trueAbilities.name: Vital Drain
trueAbilities.description:
You make a Precise Attack against the target creature that deals Earth damage equal to their Toughness with Full Pierce.  On damage the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for the damage dealt.

Vital Drain can be casted from the location of the host of your Spore Symbiote.

trueAbilities.name: Vital Drive
trueAbilities.description: You regain HP equal to 5 times the mana spent.

trueAbilities.name: Vital Drive II
trueAbilities.description: You regain HP equal to five times the mana spent. Vital Drive II cannot heal more than the damage you took from the triggering attack.
trueAbilities.requirement: You took damage from an attack.

trueAbilities.name: Vivisect
trueAbilities.description: You cut the target in half with your scissors or chainsaw, killing them instantly.
trueAbilities.requirement: Giant Scissors or Chainsaw only. Target is affected by Expose and is a grunt.

trueAbilities.name: Volley
trueAbilities.description: You make a Light attack against all targets in a 25x25ft area.

trueAbilities.name: Wall Formation
trueAbilities.description: Until the start of your next turn, every ally within range gains Wall Formation. If they are adjacent to another ally gains a +1 bonus to their guard and a +4 bonus to their block value.

trueAbilities.name: Warm Together
trueAbilities.description: When you have “Just A Hug” active. You and the target gain resistance to cold from environmental effects.

trueAbilities.name: Warning Shot
trueAbilities.description: You fire a warning shot against a target in your range. Your next basic attack or Ricochet ability with a pistol against that target gains the Trick Attack keyword.

trueAbilities.name: Weapon Maintenance
trueAbilities.description:
You recall having previously assisted an ally in maintaining their weapon, causing it to be in top shape for battle. This weapon gains a +1 Power Material Bonus or +1 Focus Material Bonus. If you smithed the weapon it gains both. This Artisan bonus is considered the same bonus as from a weapon's material like Tamahagane and does not stack with it.

If the weapon you choose gets no bonus from this ability, it's critical range instead improves by 1. (A normal weapon now crits on a 19 and 20, a katana on a 18, 19 and 20).
trueAbilities.requirement: 1 Ally’s Smithed Weapon, or your own smithed weapon.

trueAbilities.name: Weighing the Heart
trueAbilities.description: You get a +5 Expertise bonus to insight checks when looking to discern if someone is lying to you.

trueAbilities.name: Weight of the Mountain
trueAbilities.description:
You prepare to strike with enhanced power.

Your next attack with a two-handed melee weapon this turn loses the keywords: Lock On and Sure Hit. In addition, you do not gain accuracy from your Focus on the enhanced attack. The attack also cannot benefit from Offstep and similar effects that guarantee the attack hits.

Instead, the attack deals extra damage equal to the accuracy lost from not gaining Focus due to Weight of the Mountain. If the attack is a heavy or precise attack, it deals extra damage equal to double the accuracy lost instead. 

If the attack made with this effect already did not benefit from focus, this ability has no effect.

trueAbilities.name: Weight of the World
trueAbilities.description: You increase the target’s gravity, reducing their elevation by 40ft. This may interrupt movement and if you reduce their elevation down to 0, you slam them into the ground dealing fall damage for the distance they failed to move and knocking them prone.
trueAbilities.requirement: Target enemy is flying or jumping.

trueAbilities.name: Whisper of the Streets
trueAbilities.description: You recall conversations you had with business partners. This grants you a +5 to any Reason check.

trueAbilities.name: White Thunder
trueAbilities.description: You target a Glacial Wall in range and fire a bolt of Frost energy that requires line of sight. On impact, the wall is destroyed and explodes into blades of ice, attacking all enemies within 5ft of the destroyed wall with a Precise attack that deals Frost damage. On damage, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

trueAbilities.name: Wild Bloom
trueAbilities.description: You apply Regrowth to up to 5 (including yourself) allies within range.

trueAbilities.name: Wild Thrusts
trueAbilities.description:
You rapidly thrust your weapon in front of you, making a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide, 10ft long box in front of you. Until the start of your next turn, you may make Attacks of Opportunity against any enemy walking through that box. You cannot make any other Attacks of Opportunity while this effect lasts.

You may cancel this effect for 0 RP.
trueAbilities.requirement: Polearm only.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Blast
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Wind against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Blast II
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy Attack (2 AP) that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Buffet
trueAbilities.description: You blow wind in a 30ft, 60ft degree cone in your chosen direction. All caught in the cone must make a save against your Potency or be blown back to the end of the cone and knocked Prone. Enemies with a size smaller than you suffer a 1d4 penalty to this roll, while enemies bigger than you get a 1d4 bonus instead. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Infusion
trueAbilities.description: You surround the willing target in protective winds, changing their typing to Wind II. As a Wind II type, they take regular damage from all other elements, but only half damage from Wind or Earth damage or from attacks with the Wind or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Frost damage or attacks with the Frost keyword. While the ward lasts, they gain a +2 bonus to their Evasion against ranged weapon attacks. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Scatter
trueAbilities.description:
You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area must make a save against Potency or be pushed back 15ft away from the point you selected.

Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Shield
trueAbilities.description: You grant the target  1 RP that must be spent on the basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well as Wind Shield. Wind Shield grants a bonus to Dodge equal to your Focus against the triggering attack. The triggering attack can also no longer benefit from Lock On or Sure Hit
trueAbilities.requirement: Ally is targeted by a ranged attack.

trueAbilities.name: Wind Wall
trueAbilities.description: You create a wall of wind that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high that slows down all ranged weapon attacks passing through it, treating them as having only half the normal range. This wall must be a straight line. These attacks also lose the Lock On, Sure Hit, Half Pierce, Guard Crush and Full Pierce keywords. In addition, the targets of those attacks are treated as having +2 Evasion and +1 Guard. Any Spells that are considered attacks (those that require an accuracy roll against a person that isn’t using the Block reaction) that pass through the wall also suffer this penalty.

trueAbilities.name: Wind-Empowered Aim
trueAbilities.description: You project Wind-Empowered Aim aura around yourself that empowers the ranged attacks of your allies. When a heroic ally within 20ft of you (including yourself) makes a ranged attack, they may add 1d4 to the accuracy roll. Upkeep: You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the Aura fades.

trueAbilities.name: Wind-up Punch
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Heavy attack against the target. Overcharge: You may spend additional AP when using this ability to deal an additional Light Damage per AP used. Add all of this damage together before applying damage reduction from Guard or abilities.

trueAbilities.name: Wire Sweep
trueAbilities.description: You whip your wire to ensnare the target. If they fail their save against your Potency+2 they are rendered Prone and take Light Damage.
trueAbilities.requirement: Saboteur Threaded Dagger only.

trueAbilities.name: Wither the Stalk
trueAbilities.description:
You strike an enemy with an attack that saps their strength. You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target cannot add their Power for damage to their next attack.

Does not work against Boss enemies.
trueAbilities.requirement: Scythe only

trueAbilities.name: X-Attack
trueAbilities.description: You give your summon a +1 Focus and +1 Power buff.
trueAbilities.requirement: Can only target your summoned animal.

trueAbilities.name: Zap
trueAbilities.description: You may make a Light attack against the target, dealing Lightning damage. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus X 3.

trueAbilities.name: Zhen Jiao
trueAbilities.description: When you move toward an enemy as part of a Martial Artist or Bajiquan ability due to Fire Stance or an inherent move effect of the ability (such as Rushing Knee Drop), your attack deals three extra points of damage for every 5ft moved. If your attack hits more than once or more than one target, you only apply this damage once.

keyAbilities.name: Acolyte's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in light armor, shields and a single common group of weapons. This group may include Channeling Weapons, even though they aren't consider common weapons. (But you only get 1 of the possible channeling weapons).
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You are welcome at establishments for your religion and they are obligated to help you with lodging, advice, food and sometimes equipment.
keyAbilities.benefit4: Upon Mastery of the class, you gain Elemental Mastery in your chosen Divine's element (or Holy if just human).

keyAbilities.name: Advanced Artificing
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Artificer Advanced Crafting Abilities
keyAbilities.benefit2: You are able to craft artifices that cost 10000 clim or less.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain +1 Burden that must be spent on an artifice.

keyAbilities.name: Adventurer Essentials
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in 1 common weapon group. In addition, you gain proficiency in 1 common or specialized weapon groups.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in 1 armor category of your choosing. Alternatively, you may pick the shield or greatshield.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use Presence Concealment.

keyAbilities.name: Aerial Mage
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Aerial Mode Switch.
keyAbilities.benefit2: While grounded and riding an Aerial Stave, you may reload 2 shells instead of 1 when taking the Reload Artifice basic action on your staff. You may do this even if your hands would normally be full and can draw both shells with 1 action.

keyAbilities.name: Aftershocks
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Aftershock.
keyAbilities.benefit2: When using a Fighter, Highlander or Reaver ability that compares Power against a Boss type enemy, you may treat your Power as 2 higher for that purpose. (Does not affect the dmg roll etc)

keyAbilities.name: Air Stability
keyAbilities.benefit1: The cavalier’s Rider & Mount As One ability applies even while flying. Any damage you take while flying on a flying mount will cause you to lose altitude as if your mount took damage.

keyAbilities.name: Angelic Presence
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Angelic Presence, which gives a +1 to Presence.

keyAbilities.name: Armorsmith Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in light armor, medium armor and shields.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in 1 basic melee weapon and can use a smith's hammer as a bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can craft armors, shields and cloaks using Iron, Tamahagane, Animal Hide and Direhide, as well as alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain Armorsmith Core Crafting abilities.

keyAbilities.name: Armorsmithing Expert
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain the Master Armorer's core crafting abilities
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may craft using Mithril, Orihalcum, Primehide and Dragonscale materials.

keyAbilities.name: Arms Mastery
keyAbilities.benefit1: You are considered proficient with every melee weapon you wield (This does not count as being proficient for class requirements).

keyAbilities.name: Artificer Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Artificer Core Crafting Abilities
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can now craft Artifices and Firearms. You are able to craft artifices that cost 2500 clim or less.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain proficiency in the musket and the Artificer's Multitool.

keyAbilities.name: Augmented Casting - Increased Reach
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Increased Reach.

keyAbilities.name: Augmented Casting - Persistent Spell
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Persistent Spell.

keyAbilities.name: Authority
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may treat any roll on Negotiation and Intimidation checks that are below 10 as being a 10 and may spend 2 mana before rolling to treat the roll as a 20 instead.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes an Domination Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

keyAbilities.name: Benevolence
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy
keyAbilities.benefit2: Your attacks do not consume Illumination on miss.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may choose not to use the effect of Illumination on a target.(Must be declared before an attack is made).

keyAbilities.name: Bone Armor
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Bone Armor.

keyAbilities.name: Botany Study
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain the ability to detect if foraged food is poisonous or unsafe to eat, nearly guaranteeing its safety.  If it is a common poison, you can also identify its effect.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain the ability to properly process some poisonous mushrooms, fruits and herbs, making them edible as a Camp Action.  You can process up to 100u at a time.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain the ability to harvest Tier 2 Foraging Outcrops.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain proficiency in Artifice Chainsaws and may use it as a gathering tool.

keyAbilities.name: Boundless Wind
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Boundless Wind Stance.

keyAbilities.name: Brace
keyAbilities.benefit1: When using the Prepare action to prepare a melee attack with a polearm, if your target of that prepared attack moved more than 20ft that turn (excluding teleports), your attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage. Against a mounted enemy this also gains Sure Hit and on damage, their movement becomes 0 until the start of your turn.
keyAbilities.benefit2: On mastering this class, the Sure Hit property (but not the movement nullification) of your prepared attack against mounted enemies now also applies against Beast type enemies that are large size or bigger.

keyAbilities.name: Cannon Expert
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Cannons.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Your attacks with the Cannon keyword ignore the 1 attack limitation of cannons.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use Rocket Jump.

keyAbilities.name: Carpenter Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can use a carpenters chisel as a crafting tool for carpenters crafts and buildings.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using Pine and Maple, as well as alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain proficiency in axes. You also gain proficiency in either bows or crossbows.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You can use the Carpenter's core crafting abilities.

keyAbilities.name: Celestial Artillery
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking an enemy outdoors that’s further than 80ft away, your spells with the Celestial keyword gain the Artillery keyword.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Comet.

keyAbilities.name: Cloudstep
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Cloudstep.

keyAbilities.name: Controlled Blaze
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you deal Fire Damage, you may choose not to ignite flammable objects.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain Fire Mastery.

keyAbilities.name: Controlled Opportunities
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Heavy Armor proficiency.
keyAbilities.benefit2: When making an attack of opportunity, you gain a +2 bonus to the accuracy and damage roll.

keyAbilities.name: Controlled Wind
keyAbilities.benefit1: When pushing a target back or up with a Wind Spell, you may choose to push up to the maximum distance instead of always pushing the maximum distance.

keyAbilities.name: Cool Spotlight
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your Idol songs gain +15ft range.  This stacks with other key abilities that increase their range.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Your One Beat, One Heart song does not count towards your song limit.
keyAbilities.benefit3: When paying upkeep for One Beat, One Heart, you may spend 1 mana to double its effect.

keyAbilities.name: Craft Weapons
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Blacksmith Core Crafting Abilities.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using the Iron and Tamahagane base materials, as well as any alloys. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use a Smith’s Hammer as a crafting tool for blacksmithing crafts. You may also use it as a Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain proficiency in 1 smithing weapon.

keyAbilities.name: Culinary Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Culinarian Core Crafting Abilities
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft stocks using advanced and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use a Frying Pan as a crafting tool for culinarian crafts. You may also use it as a Light Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain proficiency in small weapons.

keyAbilities.name: Cultivator's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in light armor, light swords and another weapon of your choice.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Appraise, Athletics, Deception, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation, Stealth or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

keyAbilities.name: Dark Surge
keyAbilities.benefit1: After you deal damage to yourself, you gain Dark Surge for your next unarmed attack that turn. Dark Surge gives you +1 Accuracy.

keyAbilities.name: Dark Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Dark Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

keyAbilities.name: Death Perception
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Death Perception.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes a Shinigami Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

keyAbilities.name: Deflect Everything
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use your Parry ability against every kind of attack, as well as against Save effects that you could Block.

keyAbilities.name: Dimensional Armory
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can create a pocket dimension with Dimensional Armory.  Creating the pocket dimension and establishing its door takes 1 week and costs 1 errand point.  The entry point can be any regular door that you fit through.  When the creator opens this door, they can decide instead to access the Dimensional Armory, which is a 15ft x 15ft closet.  This closet can hold up to 6 Burden worth of items.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory (GM’s discretion), such as Divine Arms not bonded to you.  If the owner of a Dimensional Armory dies, everything inside of it appears in the next unoccupied space possible next to the owner.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Any burden reducing items (such as an alchemy rig) in the armory have no effect.

keyAbilities.name: Disable Magic
keyAbilities.benefit1: When using Decipher Magic, you are able to disable both tier 1 and tier 2 level bounded fields.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You are able to disable or change who is excluded from your own Bounded Fields for 0 RP.

keyAbilities.name: Discern Immunities
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Discern Immunities.

keyAbilities.name: Divine Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal the damage of your chosen Divine instead. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may choose to have your weapon emit light as if it was a lantern. You can enable or disable this effect for 1 AP.

keyAbilities.name: Draw Elements
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Draw Elements.

keyAbilities.name: Draw Elements II
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Draw Elements II.

keyAbilities.name: Earth Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Earth Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

keyAbilities.name: Elemental Convergence
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Elemental Convergence.

keyAbilities.name: Emergency Shields
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may cast Power Word: Shield and Power Word: Guardian Shield (when obtained) by spending 1 RP instead of 2 AP.

keyAbilities.name: Empty Body
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Empty Body.

keyAbilities.name: Envenom Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Envenom Weapon.

keyAbilities.name: Eternal Flames
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you would apply Burning on your turn, you instead apply Hellfire. Hellfire functions like Burning, but it can no longer be removed the normal way if not removed before the end of the target’s next turn. Hellfire can be applied to enemies immune to Burning, but it can still be removed like normal even after a turn has passed. Hellfire is automatically removed at the end of the encounter.
keyAbilities.benefit2: If you apply Hellfire to a target that is already burning, you deal extra fire damage equal to your Power.

keyAbilities.name: Eternal Mirane Cage
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Eternal Mirane Cage.

keyAbilities.name: Evil Eye
keyAbilities.benefit1: While you have a Mystic Eye active, you gain a +10 Mystic Eye bonus to perception checks relying on sight.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes an Evil Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

keyAbilities.name: Execute the Heretic
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Execute Heretic

keyAbilities.name: Expanded Circuits
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Expanded Circuits, which gives +2 maximum mana.

keyAbilities.name: Expanded Menagerie
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may spend 1 mana with using Summon Animal to choose which animal you summon.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You add the Cheetah and Landshark to the pool of animals you can summon.

keyAbilities.name: Expert Alchemist
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Alchemeister Core Crafting Abilities.
keyAbilities.benefit2: When using Throw Potion, you may infuse it using your own mana. You spend X mana and the mana cost the target needs to pay to benefit from the potion is reduced by X (the mana cost cannot go below 0).

keyAbilities.name: Expert Farmer
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use the Agrarian's core crafting abilities.

keyAbilities.name: Expert Scribe
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain +5 points in Art: Calligraphy expertise skill. This is not doubled for expertise bonus.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may draw scrolls, talismans or similar objects for 0 AP once per turn. When you do, reduce the AP cost of that talisman by 1. Even if you do not consume the talisman, it only benefits from the AP reduction once per turn.

keyAbilities.name: Faerie Light Eyes
keyAbilities.benefit1: Faerie Light Eyes provide protection against Illusions, giving you the ability to immediately see the reality warping distortions that illusions cause.  The user is not only notified of illusions, but immune to all but your own.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes a Faerie Light Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

keyAbilities.name: Fallen Friend
keyAbilities.benefit1: When an Heroic tier ally reaches 0 HP, you may immediately enter Rage Stance for 0 AP and RP as well as 0 mana. You can use this even if you don’t have the Rage ability yet.

keyAbilities.name: Fancy Footwork
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency with Dueling Weapons. While wielding a dueling weapon, you also gain the light blades' Nimble ability, even if not wielding or proficient with light blades.

keyAbilities.name: Farming Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in the scythe specialized weapon and can use it as farming tool. You also gain proficiency in the Sickle and can use it as a farming tool and One-Handed axe.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can plant seeds in plots of land that sprout into harvestable Food and Alchemy materials. You can work 10 plots of land.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain Farmer core abilities.

keyAbilities.name: Fighter's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in 5 common weapons groups.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in all light armor, medium armor and normal shields.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain +5 HP.

keyAbilities.name: Fire Stance
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Tempestuous Fire Stance

keyAbilities.name: Fire Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Fire Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

keyAbilities.name: Five Harmonies
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Luminous Form Stance.

keyAbilities.name: Focused Weapons
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Forgemaster Core Crafting Abilities.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using Mithril and Orihalcum.

keyAbilities.name: Forager's Path
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Giant Scissors and proficiency in your choice between Axes or Hori. You may use axes for harvesting foraging outcrops.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain the ability to harvest Tier 1 Foraging Outcrops.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain the ability to use natural item as replacements for an Adventurers Kit and Torches such as:  using the sun/moss as a compass, using vines as rope etc.  The material must be available (GM’s discretion)
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain the ability to create Wood Blocks as an Errand.  See item: Carpenter Materials. You may use an IP to do this 4 times instead.

keyAbilities.name: Frost Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Frost Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

keyAbilities.name: Fungal Metabolite
keyAbilities.benefit1: Due to symbiotic fungi within your body, you become resistant to all commonly known (book) poisons and may use Resist Poison.
keyAbilities.benefit2: After being infected by an exotic poison or disease and surviving, that poison/disease is added to your list of resistances. Any disease or poison that you are resistant to can be used with Amoxicillin.
keyAbilities.benefit3: Against a poison you are resistant to, you may use Resist Poison for 0 RP, 1 Mana instead of 1 RP.

keyAbilities.name: Giant Strength
keyAbilities.benefit1: While in Rage Stance, you may choose to have your size be treated as one size bigger than it actually is. You get an additional +5 bonus to Fitness checks during Rage stance regardless.

keyAbilities.name: Gravity Master
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you push or pull an enemy on your turn, you may spend 1 mana to increase this distance by 10ft. You may also spend 1 mana to instead ignore the effects of 1 source of Immovable on a target you’re attempting to push, unless that target is permanently Immovable.

keyAbilities.name: Greatshield Master
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Greatshields. While wearing a Greatshield, any ally standing behind you that is the target of a ranged attack may treat you as high cover.

keyAbilities.name: Gun Martial Arts
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can fire your pistols while in melee range of an enemy without provoking attacks of opportunity.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can make unarmed attacks even if carrying a pistol in both hands. If wielding a weapon other than a pistol, this no longer applies. When wielding only pistols and no other weapons, your unarmed attacks benefit from your pistol material bonuses.

keyAbilities.name: Gunslinger's Agility
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in pistols.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +1 Gunslinger bonus to Initiative.

keyAbilities.name: Heavy Cavalry
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Medium Armor and Heavy Armor proficiency.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Every enemy damaged by your Trample effects become Challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

keyAbilities.name: Holy Orders
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Holy Orders.

keyAbilities.name: Iaijutsu
keyAbilities.benefit1: If you become the target of an attack while you're surprised, you may still react to it and any special properties of an attack that require you to be unaware of the attack (such as Killshot) do not apply to it.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may sheathe and draw katanas for 0 AP once per turn per katana.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You start each battle in the 'Iai' state, which is used for Iai abilities. Making an attack with a katana removes the Iai state for that weapon. Using a skill that requires the Iai state requires the weapon to be sheathed and will remove the Iai state for ALL your weapons, unless specified otherwise.

keyAbilities.name: Ice Cold
keyAbilities.benefit1: You are immune to Slows and difficult terrain effects with the Frost keyword.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You are immune to regular weather effects involving cold.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain Frost Mastery.  Mastery of an element allows you to use it in Channeling weapon attacks and use it to perform minor tricks relating to it.

keyAbilities.name: Idol's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in wands, small weapons and light armor.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points in Art. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use One Beat, One Heart

keyAbilities.name: Improved Death Perception
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can see the death of non-living things allowing you to automatically do maximum, full pierce damage against objects.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You apply 1 Mark of Death every time you hit an enemy with ‘Lines of Death’ or ‘Point of Death’ up to a maximum of 7 marks.

keyAbilities.name: Improvised Weaponry
keyAbilities.benefit1: When using improvised weapons, they deal the same damage as normal weapons would.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Chair Grab.
keyAbilities.benefit3: Upon mastering this class, your improvised weapon attacks all gain the Prone keyword.

keyAbilities.name: Inconspicuous
keyAbilities.benefit1: If you're traveling stealthily, you may roll separate stealth checks even if traveling with the party. When doing this, any surprise rounds for you are determined purely off your own rolls and not your parties.
keyAbilities.benefit2: During a surprise round, enemies you attack are still treated as having 0 RP for the purposes of ability requirements even after you attack them until they start their turn. You still gain this benefit, even if your allies attacked them already.

keyAbilities.name: Independent Actor
keyAbilities.benefit1: When working alone (No known allies within 300ft of you) you gain a +10 bonus to Perception, Insight, Survival and Stealth checks. Must be alone for at least 15 minutes to gain this benefit.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain a +5 bonus in Art (Cartography) expertise. This is not doubled for expertise bonus.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use Scout’s Retreat.
keyAbilities.benefit4: Having an Aetherie or similar connection active automatically fails the ‘No known allies’ requirements.

keyAbilities.name: Infiltrate
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you use Decipher Magic, you may use Roguecraft instead of Magic as the skill for it. In addition, you can modify the effect in such a way that it no longer affects you and your allies rather than completely disabling it.

keyAbilities.name: Jump
keyAbilities.benefit1: When using an ability with the Jump keyword, you do not take fall damage.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Jump.

keyAbilities.name: Knight of Yggdrasil
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Fluttering Blade.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Once per round, if an enemy is holding a weapon affected by your Fluttering Blade, you may spend 1 RP to deal Heavy Full Pierce damage to it.
keyAbilities.benefit3: When a Fluttering Blade you created is within 5ft of you, you may spend 0 AP to grab hold of it with a free hand.

keyAbilities.name: Knight of Yggdrasil II
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Fae Knight Style: Willow Stance

keyAbilities.name: Light Cavalry
keyAbilities.benefit1: While mounted and while you and your mount both wear light armor or no armor, you ignore natural difficult terrain.

keyAbilities.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
keyAbilities.benefit1: When the Static you apply deals damage to an enemy, that enemy becomes afflicted with Static X, where X is the value of the Static that damaged it.

keyAbilities.name: Lightning Weapon
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Lightning Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

keyAbilities.name: Living Cover
keyAbilities.benefit1: While mounted, any ally within 5ft of you may use you as Low Cover. If an attack would miss them because of your cover benefit, the attack instead hits you.

keyAbilities.name: Look of Death
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Perish.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes an Destruction Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

keyAbilities.name: Lord's Dominion
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can partially resist the effect of the sun. You may now spend 1 round in the sun before you start taking damage. Spending a turn outside of the sun resets this effect, giving you another round where you do not suffer the negative effects.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +1 Vampire Lord bonus to Presence.

keyAbilities.name: Mage Armor
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Mage Armor

keyAbilities.name: Mage Knight
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may also use Canter after casting a spell.

keyAbilities.name: Mage of the Tides
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can use Blue Tide.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain Elemental Mastery: Water
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain the ability to walk on water and skate across its surface—every 10ft of water surface movement only costs 5ft of movement.

keyAbilities.name: Mage's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in the Channeling weapon group's weapons and gain Arcane Mastery. Mastery of an element allows you to use it in Channeling weapon attacks and use it to perform minor tricks relating to it.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points in the Magic skill. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use Sense Magic.

keyAbilities.name: Magic Resistance
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain a +2 Anti-Mage bonus to your saves against Spells.

keyAbilities.name: Maid Training
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in staves (broom), small weapons, sets of missiles and light armor.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain 5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Stealth, Roguecraft, Medicine, Common Knowledge, Linguistics, Appraise, History, Perception, Insight, Survival or Intimidation. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use Graceful Service.

keyAbilities.name: Mana Sight
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Mana Sight.
keyAbilities.benefit2: One of your eyes becomes an Life Perception Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.
keyAbilities.benefit3: When making an attack with the Mystic Eye keyword that use the Life Perception eye, you ignore 1 point of guard.

keyAbilities.name: Martial Artist's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation or a relevant Expert Knowledge skill (By DM approval). You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use Discipline.

keyAbilities.name: Mass Index
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your spells with the Gravity keyword deal extra damage to the target based on its size. They deal an additional 1 damage to large creatures and an additional 3 to Huge creatures.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Gravity Crush.

keyAbilities.name: Medic's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in small weapons, set of missiles and light armor.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Medicine. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain the benefits of First Response.

keyAbilities.name: Mending
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may spend an EP to restore a Broken item. Some items (such as consumables) cannot be repaired (GM’s discretion).

keyAbilities.name: Merchant Lord
keyAbilities.benefit1: Procurement Limit increases to 3000 and you can procure materials that cost <= 3000 clim per ingot/block.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in Pistols.
keyAbilities.benefit3: Upon mastering this class, the Procurement Limit increases to 4000 and you can procure materials that cost <= 4000 clim per ingot/block.

keyAbilities.name: Mime's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in 1 common and 1 specialized weapon
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Art. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: As a mime, you’re not allowed to speak. If you speak during an encounter, you cannot use any Mime abilities until the end of the encounter.

keyAbilities.name: Mission Control
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in the Aetherie Sensory Station.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Mind Connection.

keyAbilities.name: Mounted Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Polearms, Lances, Light armor, Shields and one other common weapon group of your choice.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain 5 skill points in Riding. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use Spirit Jump.
keyAbilities.benefit4: If you have mastered cavalier, your mount can withstand one lethal blow. If your mount would be reduced to 0 HP or below by an attack, it instead is reduced to 1 HP. Only works once per encounter.

keyAbilities.name: Natural Cycle
keyAbilities.benefit1: At the start of your turn you may pay upkeep 1 mana for each Regrowth you have on an ally. If you do, you may extend its duration by 1 turn. You can choose this upkeep separately for each Regrowth.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Regrowth.

keyAbilities.name: Nightstalker
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain 60ft darkvision, allowing you to see perfectly in the dark even without a source of light. If you already have darkvision, the range of it improves by 60ft.

keyAbilities.name: Ninja Style
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in both Small Weapons and Sets of Missiles.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Ninja Run.

keyAbilities.name: Ninja Techniques
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your Ninja Run now lasts for the entire turn.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Genjutsu Kai

keyAbilities.name: On my terms
keyAbilities.benefit1: While you are at 1 HP or higher, damage (including true damage) you take during your own turn cannot reduce you below 1 HP.
keyAbilities.benefit2: When you roll a 1 on a skill check, something unexpected may happen (GM's discretion). This is usually bad, but it could also turn out to be a blessing in disguise.

keyAbilities.name: Ore Hunter
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can gather Tier 2 mining outcrops.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You are an expert and tying knots. Using rope, you can secure yourself to objects and safely rappel down to investigate down cliffsides.

keyAbilities.name: Overwhelming Critical
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you roll a critical hit while making a Heavy attack with a Two-Handed weapon you may use Aftershock even if the attack didn’t miss. This use doesn’t count against the normal use limit of it and this effect still applies even if the critical hit was blocked or otherwise defended against.

keyAbilities.name: Past Self
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Past Self.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and may use it multiple times.

keyAbilities.name: Peddler of Wares
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your in-combat burden capacity increases by 1.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain proficiency in 1 common weapon group.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain +5 skill points in Riding. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit4: Upon mastering this class, the Procurement Limit increases to 2000 and you can procure materials that cost <= 2000 clim per ingot/block.

keyAbilities.name: Perfect Mimicry
keyAbilities.benefit1: When given enough preparation time and enough knowledge about the subject, you are able to perfectly impersonate another person (GM’s discretion on what is ‘enough’). When disguised in this way, other people are unable to see through your disguise through normal means unless you act or say things that are strange enough to draw suspicions. This disguise is partially magical in nature, but cannot make up for obvious size or shape differences.

keyAbilities.name: Phantom Thief
keyAbilities.benefit1: You are able to disable and modify t2 and t3 bounded fields.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Stolen Skill.

keyAbilities.name: Pierrot's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in small weapons, bludgeoning weapons and light armor.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Art. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain 2 Damage Reduction against pies.

keyAbilities.name: Puppet Grandmaster
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can summon puppets under your control using Summon Piece. While these puppets follow movement rules as described in the abilities and are always Medium size, they can appear as whatever you wish, decided when you take this class.
keyAbilities.benefit2: As an EP action, you may change the appearance of your pieces.

keyAbilities.name: Raise Undead
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Raise Undead.

keyAbilities.name: Ranger's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in light and medium armor, a common ranged weapon group and a common melee weapon group.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain 5 points in one of the following: Appraise, Athletics, Stealth, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Animal Husbandry or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use Status Assessment.

keyAbilities.name: Rapid Blasts
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Ki Blast II.

keyAbilities.name: Receive Oracle
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Receive Oracle.

keyAbilities.name: Recover Power
keyAbilities.benefit1: Any temporary HP on you at the end of an encounter is converted into healing. You regain HP equal to half the value of temporary HP you have remaining.

keyAbilities.name: Resheathe
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Resheathe.

keyAbilities.name: Rock and Stone
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in 1 armor or in the shield. You also gain proficiency in the Pickaxe specialty weapon.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain the ability to gather mining outcrops.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain the ability to create Ingots as an Errand.  See item: Blacksmithing Materials. You may use an IP to do this 4 times instead.

keyAbilities.name: Rogue's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency with light armor and with one of the following weapon groups: Small weapons, Light swords, Dueling weapons and Set of missiles.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points in Roguecraft and +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Stealth, Deception, Perception, Insight, Negotiation, Intimidation or a relevant Expert Knowledge skill (By DM Approval).  You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use Feint.

keyAbilities.name: Rolling Thunder
keyAbilities.benefit1: After moving at least 40ft in a turn, your next unarmed strike that turn gains a +2 Transcendent Lightning bonus to accuracy and damage.

keyAbilities.name: Saboteur
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Saboteur Thread Daggers.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Presence Concealment.

keyAbilities.name: Sanctioned Healer
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you attack an enemy with Sanctify, you may choose not to trigger the effect of it.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy

keyAbilities.name: Scholar of Tactics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Pistols.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Take Cover!.

keyAbilities.name: Shared Darkness
keyAbilities.benefit1: The range of your darkvision increases by 60ft.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Darkvision.

keyAbilities.name: Shield the Fallen
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Shield the Fallen.

keyAbilities.name: Shielding Fist
keyAbilities.benefit1: While you have at least 1 hand empty and aren't wielding a shield, you gain a +4 Shield bonus to your block.

keyAbilities.name: Shrug it off
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Vital Drive II.

keyAbilities.name: Snipe
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Sniper Rifles.
keyAbilities.benefit2: If you did not move this turn or the previous turn you gain a +1d4 Snipe bonus to your accuracy roll on attacks made with a Sniper Rifle.

keyAbilities.name: Song without Song
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may have 1 additional song active at the same time.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You learn the language 'Music'.

keyAbilities.name: Sorcerer's Journey
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain proficiency in Channeling Weapons and Light Armor.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain +5 skill points in Magic. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in this skill.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You gain Arcane Mastery. Upon mastering this class, you may master an additional element of your choice.

keyAbilities.name: Soul Absorption
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Soul Absorption.

keyAbilities.name: Soul Bond
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you acquire this ability, choose 1 willing person. That person is treated as your Soulmate and several of the class abilities only work on your Soulmate. This cannot be changed unless your Soulmate dies.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Your Soulmate is always treated as your VIP for any bodyguard abilities. You may still designate another VIP as normal.

keyAbilities.name: Sound the retreat
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Sound the retreat

keyAbilities.name: Spell Challenge
keyAbilities.benefit1: When targeting or damaging an enemy with a spell, you may choose to inflict Challenge on them until the end of your next turn.
keyAbilities.benefit2: When an enemy that is Challenged by you provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you may instead use Abjurer's Blast against them. The heavy and precise version of this cost 1 RP, while the light version costs 0 RP.

keyAbilities.name: Spell Transfer
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you use the Create Talisman ability, an ally may spend their Errand action to use one of their spells to put on the talisman instead of your own. You only create 1 copy of this talisman per Errand action and cannot use Secret Art spells with it.

keyAbilities.name: Spore Symbiote
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can use Spore Symbiote.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain Earth Elemental Mastery.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can create a cute mushroom cap hat to wear.

keyAbilities.name: Status Assessment II
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Status Assessment II.

keyAbilities.name: Store Time
keyAbilities.benefit1: You can use Store Time.

keyAbilities.name: Studied Healer
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Followers of your Religion are more obligated to listen to you, granting you a +5 Negotiation Bonus when dealing with them.

keyAbilities.name: Stygian Comprehension
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Dark Bolt.

keyAbilities.name: Summon Animal
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Summon Animal.

keyAbilities.name: Summoning Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may channel for 10 minutes after which you arrive at the space between worlds, allowing you to interact with Eidolons that wish to meet with you.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Attune Eidolon.

keyAbilities.name: Superconductor
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you make an attack that deals Lightning damage to a target afflicted with Static, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.

keyAbilities.name: Superior Assessment
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Status Assessment III.

keyAbilities.name: Surgical Precision
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you deal damage with a one-handed melee weapon that is both Sure Hit and Full Pierce or a critical hit, you inflict Bleeding on the target for 1 turn. This effect stacks with other Bleeds effects and itself up to 3 times.

keyAbilities.name: Take the advantage
keyAbilities.benefit1: When attacking a target inflicted with Offstep, Stagger or Blinded, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus against them.

keyAbilities.name: Terrifying Charge
keyAbilities.benefit1: When dealing damage with the trample effect or with your Secret Art: Override, any non-heroic target you damage becomes Shaken until the end of their next turn.

keyAbilities.name: The Alchemist
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Alchemist Core Crafting Abilities, and proficiency in 1 basic weapon.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can use an Alchemist's Alembic as crafting tool for alchemy crafts.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask, Poison or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once.

keyAbilities.name: Thefts of the past
keyAbilities.benefit1: When making a check with the Roguecraft skill, you may treat the object or person you’re interacting with as being up to an hour in the past. This may allow you to steal things not currently carried, open doors before they were locked and more. Does not work in combat and an item that is consumed cannot be stolen.
keyAbilities.benefit2: Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and you may use it multiple times.

keyAbilities.name: Throwing Rhythm
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you make an attack with a throwing weapon, or take the thrown attack basic action, you may move 5ft as if you had the light sword passive (Nimble).
keyAbilities.benefit2: When you take the thrown attack basic action, the weapon returns to your hand afterwards.

keyAbilities.name: Timberwright's Core Crafting
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use the Timberwright's Core Crafting abilities
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may craft using Ash and Yew materials.

keyAbilities.name: Titan's Grip
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may wield a Two-Handed weapon in 1 hand allowing you to use a second (Two-Handed) weapon or shield in your offhand.
keyAbilities.benefit2: While dual wielding Two-Handed weapons, you may make dual wield attacks as if they were One-Handed weapons.

keyAbilities.name: Toss a coin
keyAbilities.benefit1: As an Errand action, you may perform in a city or town and earn Clim equal to your relevant Art roll x 10 up to a maximum of 300 clim.

keyAbilities.name: Toxic Blast
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Toxic Blast.

keyAbilities.name: Tranquil Prayers
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your Acolyte, Priest and High Priest Healing abilities heal for 2x value when used out of combat.

keyAbilities.name: Transfusion
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Transfusion.

keyAbilities.name: Transmutation Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Transmuter Core Crafting Abilities. You may use one of these abilities in a crafting session. If you use one of these abilities, other transmuters can no longer use their co craft abilities with you. Similarly, if a co crafter uses one of these abilities for you, you can no longer use any of these abilities.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials. You may use an IP to perform an EP action tied to this key ability 4 times.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You can now craft Elixirs, Potions, Flasks and Salves. You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once.
keyAbilities.benefit4: You gain proficiency in alchemist’s alembic and 1 basic weapon type.

keyAbilities.name: Transmutation Tricks
keyAbilities.benefit1: For 1 AP, You can create small items using transmuting to provide temporary comforts and curiosities— a cup to drink out of, a chair to sit down on, a figurine etc.  These items cannot have significant gameplay factors (such as a key or a tool).  If you’d like to create something small to give away or sell, you must utilize x amount of commodities of whatever quantity and type the GM decides.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use your transmuter abilities a second time during a craft or co craft.
keyAbilities.benefit3: You may use the following abilities:

keyAbilities.name: Transmuter of Life
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may use Biohacking.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can store up to one gene in your gene inventory.

keyAbilities.name: Trap Basics
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may convert 100u of junk into a Trapper's Trap you can use for your abilities. You may do so as a Rest action or as an Errand action. Trapper's Traps are a special item that cost 1 burden.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may carry up to 3 Trapper's Traps without them costing Burden.
keyAbilities.benefit3: When resting at your camp outdoors, you may set traps that will alert you to enemies approaching by using a rest action. These do not consume a Trapper's Trap,  but allow you to use Survival to detect enemies instead of Perception. After each of such rests, you obtain 1d10 x 5 food units.

keyAbilities.name: Tremorsense
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Earth Mastery.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use Tremorsense

keyAbilities.name: Undead Mastery
keyAbilities.benefit1: For every 300 spirit core you possess above 2000, you can control 1 extra zombie with your Create Undead.

keyAbilities.name: Vampiric Strength
keyAbilities.benefit1: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient. Your unarmed attacks cannot deal non-lethal damage.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use the Vampire Bite ability.

keyAbilities.name: Versatile Range
keyAbilities.benefit1: You may treat your polearm’s threatened range as 5ft instead of 5-10ft. You must declare this during your turn and it lasts until the start of your next turn.

keyAbilities.name: VIP Protection
keyAbilities.benefit1: At the start of each arc, choose one person other than yourself as your VIP for that arc. Your VIP is the target for several of your abilities.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You may use VIP Protection.
keyAbilities.benefit3: If you choose a VIP, you cannot become the target of a VIP protection yourself.

keyAbilities.name: Wall Ride
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you create a wall on your turn using your Geomancer or Geomaster abilities, you may move along the wall as it is created. You can jump off at any point of the wall creation, ending in an empty square next to the wall.

keyAbilities.name: Wind Master
keyAbilities.benefit1: You gain Wind Mastery.
keyAbilities.benefit2: You can use Glide.

keyAbilities.name: Zhen Jiao
keyAbilities.benefit1: When you move toward an enemy as part of a Bajiquan ability, your attack deals two  extra points of damage for every 5ft moved.

ancestries.name: Ancient Marionette
ancestries.description:
Ancient Marionettes: Lost to time and sea, the Ancient Marionettes stand as enigmatic remnants of a past long forgotten. Once components of the colossal arcane superweapon known as a "Divine Arms", these constructs now serve as hosts to sentient magic, giving life and consciousness to their once dormant forms. Rescued from the wreckage of a bygone vessel that met its fate in the waters surrounding the Isle of Kirara, these inert marionettes were left on the enchanted shore, their purpose and power seemingly lost to the ages. However, the island's potent, ambient magic, a phenomenon that gives birth to the unique entities known as youkai, saw in these Ancient Marionettes an opportunity - bodies ready to house their formless essence. As the island's pervasive magic seeped into the marionettes, they awoke from their lifeless slumber. The youkai spirits, now housed in these ancient bodies, began to stir, imbuing them with a consciousness that mirrored their own. Thus, the Ancient Marionettes were reborn, not as weapons of war but as sentient beings in their own right, the symbiosis of ancient technology and living magic. Physically, Ancient Marionettes resemble their former selves - intricate, humanoid forms, wrought from an alloy seemingly immune to the ravages of time and sea. Strange, arcane symbols adorn their bodies, pulsating with a soft, ethereal glow that intensifies when they harness their magical abilities. Their eyes, once empty and hollow, now shine with the vibrant spark of sentient life. Despite their imposing exterior, these reborn constructs possess an inherent gentleness, a testament to the youkai spirit within them. They are beings of thought and contemplation, bound by a curiosity of their new existence, their strange past, and the world they find themselves in. The Ancient Marionettes stand as a testament to the transformative power of magic, a symbol of a union between the ancient and the new, and a unique addition to the diverse inhabitants of the Isle of Kirara.

Size: Medium

Winner of the 2023 Alpha Race Creation Contest (Constructs) by PurpleXCompleX.

ancestries.name: Anubis
ancestries.description:
The Anubis are a unique race of Fae from the southwestern region of Telsin, known for their deep respect for life, death, and the natural order. With dark hair, bronze skin, and their unique Jackal-like ears, the Anubis see themselves as guardians of the living and the dead alike. While their own lifespans are exceptionally long, they hold a profound reverence for the brief lives of other beings, viewing them as precious gifts to be treasured even beyond death. This belief extends to the Anubis’ role in mediating spiritual affairs and protecting the deceased from desecration.

Renowned for their honesty and strong sense of karma, the Anubis possess an almost supernatural ability to discern lies, making them respected yet sometimes avoided as arbiters. Their ceremonial attire includes light-colored clothing, adorned with golden jewelry and polished river stones—symbols of lineage often passed down or given as offerings to the deceased.

Skilled at laying disturbed spirits to rest, they hold a complex relationship with necromancy, respecting it when practiced with reverence. Anubis Necromancers act as graveyard caretakers and conduct important funerary rites, roles woven into their cultural fabric and essential to their purpose across the region, which has garnered respect in spiritual circles even as far as Northi.

Size: Medium

ancestries.name: Bearfolk
ancestries.description:
Bearfolk are a proud and enduring branch of the Chimera, towering humanoids with dense fur, heavy frames, and deep, resonant voices. Most stand a head taller than the average human and carry the strength to match it, yet behind their massive build lies a quiet and thoughtful nature. Bearfolk are often the last to speak up and do so in short sentences, not speaking any more words than are necessary.

Their culture prizes food, patience, community, and comfort. To a bearfolk, food shared is a sacred bond. Most live in small family holds scattered through the colder reaches of Northi. Their settlements, half-buried in snow and stone, are renowned for their hospitality.

Despite their imposing nature, bearfolk often display surprising cunning. They are famous, perhaps infamous, for their uncanny ability to blend into society. Through sheer confidence or a kind of cosmic absurdity, a bearfolk in a robe and hat can convince entire villages that they are “definitely not a bear.” Scholars call this phenomenon Bear Shock, and no one has yet figured out how or why it works.

Bearfolk have an uncomplicated and big love for food. To them, a good meal is one of life’s purest pleasures and a sign of prosperity hard-earned through long winters and heavy labor. They’ll eat nearly anything that fills the belly, but they have an undeniable fondness for sweets: honey, candied fruits, and rare confections that melt on the tongue. Many bearfolk adventurers quietly hoard local delicacies from the regions they visit, trading stories and bites of food with the same enthusiasm others reserve for treasure.

Bearfolk adventurers are often wanderers who leave their homes to test their might or seek rare foods from distant lands. Some serve as guardians and caravan escorts, others simply follow their instincts wherever they lead. Their role in parties is usually that of a frontliner, delivering heavy blows with their paws.

“Full belly, calm heart.”

Size: M

ancestries.name: Bullfolk
ancestries.description:
Bullfolk are a sub-race of Chimera, native to the rolling foothills around the northern mountains of Northi. Technically the same sub-race as Cowfolk, the extreme sexual dimorphism between Bullfolk and Cowfolk make them physically and visibly distinct. While Cowfolk possess short and curvy figures, Bullfolk tower over those around them with muscular builds. However, it is only the foolish that believe the hulking stature of Bullfolk is a sign of brutish agility and intelligence, as they are quite nimble and some of the most clever architects. 

Bullfolk culture prizes bonds more than any one thing. Bonds between friends, family, and partners. If a Bullfolk offers you their honest friendship, it is a friendship they will maintain and protect fiercely. If they offer you their partnership, they will never stray. This level of devotion can be off putting to some as it is often devoid of any need or requirement for reciprocation. Sometimes, especially for those used to betrayal in their lives, it feels “too good to be true”. And many don’t get the full extent of their devotion until their Bullfolk friend follows them on a harrowing journey or stands defiantly in front of a monster to protect them. But beware betraying a Bullfolk that has formed that bond with you. Because it is not your friend you will have to worry about, but their family should they ever learn about it. 

Bullfolk are often craftsmen of some kind and it is common for Bullfolk in a community to be the go-to for any construction needs. Even Bullfolk that never take up the professions of hammer, saw, and forge often have hobbies in whittling, weaving, or even painting. The most untrained Bullfolk will still have a knack for the lay of a foundation, the set of a roof, or the plane of a chair. Handmade and personal gifts are common to receive from a Bullfolk during birthdays, holidays, or special occasions.

Bullfolk adventurers are almost always a friend joining someone they care for on a journey, although some simply travel from their homes for the sheer novelty of seeing the rest of the world. They are at home in the frontline, using their size and stature to guard and protect their allies with sheer mass and devastating blows.

And importantly: headbutt a Bullfolk at your own risk.

Male only.

Size: M

ancestries.name: Cait Sith
ancestries.description:
Cait Sith are a rare subrace of the fae, distinguished by their dual forms and elusive nature within the realm of Lyr. Originating from the lands of Avalon, Cait Sith often appear as enchanting Fae adorned with delicate cat ears atop their heads, leading many to mistake them for the more common Catfolk. However, their true versatility is revealed in their ability to assume the form of an actual cat, a transformation that many Cait Sith embrace and many stay in for most of their lives. This shapeshifting capability allows them to seamlessly integrate into various environments, particularly human dwellings, where they often masquerade as beloved house cats. Their preference for a relaxed and lounging lifestyle reflects the tranquil culture of Avalon, where comfort and leisure are highly valued. In their feline guise, Cait Sith seek out the warmth and attention of humans, enjoying the care and adoration bestowed upon them.  Cait Sith are known to become irked when they do not receive the expected adoration, such as being left milk, leading them to orchestrate mischievous pranks on those who neglect their whims.

Despite their seemingly benign and playful demeanor, Cait Sith harbor a deep-seated animosity towards their mortal enemies, the Black Dogs, also known as Cu Sith. These shapeshifting dog Fae from Sylvan share an intense mutual detest, often culminating in deadly duels that underscore the severity of their rivalry. Beyond their playful tricks, Cait Sith possess a formidable and sinister ability to manipulate the life force of weakened enemies, using this dark magic as a potent weapon to eliminate threats. This unique combination of charm and lethal power makes Cait Sith both captivating and dangerous. Players who choose Cait Sith characters have the possibility of living double lives as they pretend to be normal cats, using trickery and haunting forces to their means.  Their intense rivalry with the Black Dogs can also make for some interesting and fun roleplaying moments.

Size: Medium (when not in cat form)

ancestries.name: Catfolk
ancestries.description:
The Catfolk, a subrace of the Chimera, are the most populous inhabitants of the world, surpassing even Humans in numbers. Predominantly hailing from the nation of Northi, their agile and instinctual nature once allowed them to dominate vast continents through swift and strategic warfare. Today, their presence is found everywhere, thriving from the enchanted Fae forests of Easter to the tranquil Kiraran Islands. This widespread distribution showcases their remarkable adaptability and resilience, enabling them to flourish in diverse environments and integrate seamlessly with various cultures.

Playing a Catfolk means embodying grace, agility, and a keen survival instinct. Their heritage as former rulers and fierce warriors grants them a natural prowess in both combat and leadership, making them ideal for roles that require quick thinking and dexterity. Catfolk are fiercely independent yet deeply communal, valuing both personal achievement and the strength of their kin. Whether navigating the political landscapes of Northi’s cities or exploring uncharted wilds, Catfolk characters bring a dynamic blend of tradition and innovation, resilience and adaptability, to any adventuring party

Size: Medium

ancestries.name: Centaur
ancestries.description:
Centaurs, a proud subrace of the Chimera, predominantly inhabit the expansive great plains of Northi and extend into the rugged Nuren territories of Axias. Renowned for their formidable size and unmatched speed, Centaurs thrive in open landscapes where they can harness their natural agility to navigate the vast expanses effortlessly. Their preference for the untamed wilderness often keeps them apart from bustling city life, though resilient individuals can be found adapting to urban environments despite the challenges their stature presents. Centaurs live in tight-knit tribal villages, valuing strong familial bonds within their specific tribes over a unified racial identity. This tribal allegiance fosters a deep sense of loyalty and reliability, making each Centaur a steadfast ally and a formidable presence on the battlefield.

Historically, Centaurs played a crucial role during the Great Divine War by joining the Susururu Rebellion, where their strength and speed were indispensable in both medical evacuation and logistical support. Their legacy as dependable warriors and medics underscores their reputation for being strong, fast, and reliable. However, a dark chapter in their history—enslavement by the Catfolk as mounts—has left lingering distrust towards the Catfolk, shaping their interactions and alliances in the present day. Playing a Centaur means embodying resilience and independence, drawing upon their tribal heritage to navigate both the challenges of the wild and the complexities of a world still healing from past conflicts. Centaur characters bring a unique blend of physical prowess and unwavering loyalty, making them ideal for roles that require both strength and strategic support within any adventuring party.

Size: Large

ancestries.name: Cowfolk
ancestries.description:
Cowfolk are a sub-race of Chimera, native to the rolling foothills around the northern mountains of Northi. Technically the same sub-race as Bullfolk, the extreme sexual dimorphism between Cowfolk and Bullfolk make them physically and visibly distinct. While Bullfolk tower over those around them with muscular builds, Cowfolk possess short and curvy figures. However, it is only the foolish that believe the dainty stature of Cowfolk is a vulnerability, as they are deceptively resilient and strong for their size.

Cowfolk culture prizes bonds more than any one thing. Bonds between friends, family, and partners. If a Cowfolk offers you their honest friendship, it is a friendship they will maintain and protect fiercely. If they offer you their partnership, they will never stray. This level of devotion can be off putting to some as it is often devoid of any need or requirement for reciprocation. Sometimes, especially for those used to betrayal in their lives, it feels “too good to be true”. And many don’t get the full extent of their devotion until their Cowfolk friend follows them on a harrowing journey or stands defiantly in front of a monster to protect them. But beware betraying a Cowfolk that has formed that bond with you. Because it is not your friend you will have to worry about, but their family should they ever learn about it. 

When they settle in one place for long enough, Cowfolk often get incredibly domestic and there has never been an account of an uncomfortable or unwelcoming Cowfolk home. It doesn’t matter if it’s a home, an inn room, or a long term camp site, leave a Cowfolk in one place for long enough and you’ll begin to find trinkets, warm blankets, hand made cushions, and well stocked food supplies building up over time. However, they are rarely tied down to any location and will cheerfully pack everything up or even leave things behind to continue traveling.

Cowfolk adventurers are almost always a friend joining someone they care for on a journey, although some simply travel from their homes for the sheer novelty of seeing the rest of the world. They often take up frontline roles to directly support or protect their friends as a sturdy foundation of any party’s composition.

And most importantly: never, ever ask a Cowfolk for her milk unless you share a very, very close bond with her.

Female only

Size: M

ancestries.name: Cu Sith
ancestries.description:
Cu Sith are a rare subrace of Fae, distinguished by their dual forms and steadfast nature. They originated from the lands of Sylvan within Easter and appear as enchanting, dogfolk-like Fae with dog ears atop their heads and emotive tails. Their true forms, however, are that of a small or medium sized dog, indistinguishable from any normal dog. This shapeshifting allows them to blend into most environments, especially areas with other races, where they sometimes take on the role of beloved pet or guardian. They can form strong bonds with others in this guise and history is full of stories of mysteriously intelligent dogs caring for their owners, rescuing children, or driving off attackers from families and villages. 

One particularly strange series of events in history involved the royal family pet of the Kingdom of Sayce. Located on the eastern edge of Northi on the shores of Sayce Lake, the small kingdom held a double dominating trade position of controlling lake and river travel in eastern Northi and also airship travel as they benefited from a major leyline running through the kingdom. Shortly before King Leonard Rune Leon of Northi began his push for unifying the entire country, the Trehaerne family colluded with the neighboring Kingdom of Eynion in an attempt to overthrow the Sayce’s and take control of the Kingdom by allowing assassins to stage in their estate. If things had gone to plan, the entire Sayce family would have been wiped out and the Trehaerne’s would have inherited the throne. However, in a series of unbelievable events, the Sayce family dog tripped up, foiled, uncovered, and in one account, even took up a sword in his jaws and fought off an assassin when he went directly after Princess Lowri in a furious duel. The machinations of the Trehaerne family and the Kingdom of Eynion was presented to King Leonard and justice was seen to, the Kingdom of Sayce was one of the first to join the growing movement of unification. After that event, regardless of the truth behind the more exaggerated stories, the Sayce Royal Flag has included the silhouette of that dog.

Because of their loyal and dedicated nature, Cu Sith have a deep hatred toward the flighty and cruel Cait Sith. The shapeshifting cats from Avalon share this mutual detestment and this often leads to deadly duels. It is speculated that Cu Sith began to venture out into the wider world beyond Easter as a direct opposition to the Cait Sith and to protect others from being taken advantage of. The Cu Sith’s haunting bark is one of their most useful tools in driving off or defeating Cait Sith and also reinforces the perception of the deep animosity between cats and dogs.

Size: M

ancestries.name: Dogfolk
ancestries.description:
Dogfolk are renowned for their unwavering culture of loyalty and honor, embodying the virtues that make them esteemed allies and steadfast companions within the realm of Lyr. Their deep-seated sense of duty often leads them to trust and support those to whom they have sworn allegiance, even in the face of betrayal. This inherent trustworthiness has, unfortunately, made Dogfolk susceptible to exploitation throughout history. Prior to the reign of King Leo of Northi, the fragmented kingdoms and city-states of the Catfolk frequently abused the Dogfolk’s loyalty, coercing them into servitude and neglecting their rightful honor. King Leo's ascension marked a pivotal shift, as he championed the protection of Dogfolk rights and endeavored to eradicate the oppressive practices that had long plagued them.
