monsterAbilities.description: A creature attacking you suffers a stacking -1 penalty to their agility as they struggle to avoid meeting the creature’s petrifying gaze. Every turn not spent attacking the basilisk restores 1 agility to the character.

monsterAbilities.name: Phase through
monsterAbilities.description: You may move through solid objects and enemies with no penalty.

monsterAbilities.name: Poison Tail
monsterAbilities.description: When making a basic Light or Heavy attack with your tail, you inflict Daze on dealing damage. If the target is already Dazed, you instead deal 5 (Light) or 10 (Heavy) Full Pierce Poison damage.

monsterAbilities.name: Prismatic Adaptability
monsterAbilities.description: When struck by a magical attack, you gain 100 Damage Reduction to that attack element indefinitely. You can only have one instance of this adaptability at a time.

monsterAbilities.name: Razorsharp
monsterAbilities.description: You bladelike arms are razor sharp, causing the target to bleed when hit. When you deal damage to a target wearing no armor or light armor, you deals an additional Power true damage.

monsterAbilities.name: Reach
monsterAbilities.description: Your attacks can attack targets up to 10ft away.

monsterAbilities.name: Regenerating Bone
monsterAbilities.description: You regenerate Toughness HP at the start of your turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Regenerating Bone II
monsterAbilities.description: Each of your individual parts regenerates Toughness HP at the start of your turn. This continues even after a body part reaches 0 HP until all body parts have been reduced to 0 HP or lower.

monsterAbilities.name: Regeneration
monsterAbilities.description: If you were not hit with a Heavy Attack during the last turn, heal for 30 HP.

monsterAbilities.name: Repulsor Field
monsterAbilities.description: Any attack against you from further than 40ft away automatically misses.

monsterAbilities.name: Resurrection
monsterAbilities.description: When you reach 0 HP, you are revived with 1 HP at the start of your next turn. Any damage dealt to you while you have 0 HP disables this ability.

monsterAbilities.name: Revel in Death
monsterAbilities.description: If there's a corpse within 5ft of you at the start of your turn, you heal for half your maximum HP and gain a +4 bonus to accuracy checks.

monsterAbilities.name: Rush
monsterAbilities.description: A creature with Rush gets a turn immediately when being summoned, and the summoning range is increased to 60ft.  If summoned in the middle of your turn, then take this creature's turn first, then finish the remainder of your turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Shimmer
monsterAbilities.description: Your position is constantly in flux, even when not moving. Single target Sure Hit attacks are treated as Lock-on against you. You have 0 guard, but gain +2 dodge (already added to stats).

monsterAbilities.name: Shimmer Spider
monsterAbilities.description: You are permanently hidden until you attack or you are spotted with a perception check like normal (DC23).

monsterAbilities.name: Single Fin
monsterAbilities.description: When not attacking, only a single fin sticks out from under the ground. While you are not attacking, you gain a +10/+20 bonus to your dodge except against other burrowed creatures. You cannot make reactions while not underground.

monsterAbilities.name: Skeletal Part Targeting
monsterAbilities.description: You have 4 arms which can be targeted separately from the main body. For each active arm, you gain 1 AP. Each arm has 40 HP and uses the Dodge and Guard of the main body. They have 1 RP, which regenerates at the start of your turn. Each arm is attached to the main body and moves along with it. They otherwise have a movement speed of 0 and are immune to Knockbacks, Prone and other disabling effects. An AoE attack only does damage to 1 part of your body, either the main body or an arm, which is chosen by the attacker.

monsterAbilities.name: Skitter
monsterAbilities.description: Your movement in a straight line gains +10 movement speed.

monsterAbilities.name: Slime Type
monsterAbilities.description: You gain 10 Damage Reduction against physical damage, but cannot Block or Dodge attacks.

monsterAbilities.name: Slippery
monsterAbilities.description: You may use the Disengage action for 0 AP.

monsterAbilities.name: Snow Camouflage
monsterAbilities.description: You may hide inside a blizzard without requiring cover to hide behind.

monsterAbilities.name: Soft Wings
monsterAbilities.description: If you take damage from a Heavy or Precise Attack while flying, but you must immediately land. You cannot fly again until the end of your next turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Spider Climb
monsterAbilities.description: You can walk on walls as if it were solid ground. You ignore webbing and other difficult terrain created by spiders.

monsterAbilities.name: Spider Host
monsterAbilities.description: When you take damage from a weapon attack, a Burrowing Spider appears next to you, closest to the point of impact of the attack.

monsterAbilities.name: Stalk
monsterAbilities.description: You are camouflaged as you stalks your prey. You gain a bonus +10 to stealth checks and can move at full speed while hiding. When you get a surprise round, your initiative is treated as if you had rolled the maximum possible.

monsterAbilities.name: Stationary
monsterAbilities.description: You have 0 movement and can only be forcefully moved through Secret Art or Climax Art abilities.

monsterAbilities.name: Steady Stance
monsterAbilities.description: You are immune to Knockbacks and cannot be knocked prone.

monsterAbilities.name: Stealthy
monsterAbilities.description: You start the battle in stealth (10+Your stealth skill bonus) unless spotted or visible before the battle starts.

monsterAbilities.name: Sticky Movement
monsterAbilities.description: You can walk on walls as if it were solid ground.

monsterAbilities.name: Stone Skin
monsterAbilities.description: You gain +2 guard, but lose 2 agility. (Already added to stats)

monsterAbilities.name: Storm Creature
monsterAbilities.description: Your Focus, Power and Agility are doubled during a storm.

monsterAbilities.name: Strike for the Shiny, Smartly!
monsterAbilities.description: You are predisposed to attack targets who are displaying the most valuable items, Crafter numerical bonuses (Focus, Power, Crafting skill) are not perceptible but things like layering for armor or alloying weapons are, You prioritize value on weapons and artifacts, but if none of that is visible then you will default to attacking the one with the shiniest armor. You also consider current health, attempting to down (not finish off, just down) low health >25% HP targets as top priority, it’s easier to loot people who can’t fight back after all!

monsterAbilities.name: Strike for the Shiny!
monsterAbilities.description: You are predisposed to attack targets who are displaying the most valuable items, Crafter numerical bonuses (Focus, Power, Crafting skill) are not perceptible but things like layering for armor or alloying weapons are, You prioritize value on weapons and artifacts, but if none of that is visible then you will default to attacking the one with the shiniest armor.

monsterAbilities.name: Sub-Zero Body
monsterAbilities.description: Your body is freezing cold. Any melee attacks made by you deal Frost damage. Any creature touching you for an extended period of time takes Heavy Frost damage at the start of their turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Summon I
monsterAbilities.description: This summon has an upkeep of 1 AP per creature and counts as 1 towards your summon limit.

monsterAbilities.name: Summon II
monsterAbilities.description: This creature has an upkeep of 2 AP and counts as 2 towards your summon limit.

monsterAbilities.name: Superboss Resistance
monsterAbilities.description: You are immune to any status effects that would cause you to lose AP or otherwise prevent you from acting.

monsterAbilities.name: Superior Fiend Regeneration+
monsterAbilities.description: You heal for Toughness x 20 at the start of your turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Surefooted
monsterAbilities.description: You treat natural uneven terrain (rocks, fallen logs, etc.) as normal ground and can leap short spans (5–10ft) without costing extra movement.

monsterAbilities.name: Swarm
monsterAbilities.description: You only take 1 damage for each single-target attack but can take full damage from AoE attacks. You cannot make normal attacks.

monsterAbilities.name: Swarm Tactics
monsterAbilities.description: When you and other wolves move on your initiative, all of you move before making any attacks.

monsterAbilities.name: Target Rich Environment
monsterAbilities.description:
Swarm creatures are very fragile on their own and a single blow from any adventurer can dispatch you, so area of effect attacks and spells are especially effective against you. 

Each attack that is single target will do 1 damage and will take out 1 creature. AoE abilities will inflict their usual damage and take out a number of creatures equal to the damage dealt.

monsterAbilities.name: The Blur
monsterAbilities.description:
Your form blurs as it moves, due to distortions it creates in space using its mana aura. You have 25 Evasion while in The Blur. When hit by an attack or when using a defensive action, you lose The Blur. While in The Blur, you are immune to damage that is triggered by evasion/dodge such as the Axe weapon group passive.

You regain The Blur at the start of your turn.

monsterAbilities.name: Thicc Skull
monsterAbilities.description: Your skull is exceptionally hard. You are immune to Daze and non-magical Stun effects.

monsterAbilities.name: Threatening
monsterAbilities.description: When making an opportunity attack, you are treated as having 4 higher Focus and Power.

monsterAbilities.name: Tiny Wings
monsterAbilities.description: You can fly while moving, but fall down to the ground after your movement.

monsterAbilities.name: Tripping Pounce
monsterAbilities.description: On damage by any attacks made through the Pounce ability, you knock the target Prone.

monsterAbilities.name: Vine Tentacles
monsterAbilities.description: You have a melee attack range of 10ft.

monsterAbilities.name: Water Body
monsterAbilities.description: Your attacks may deal Water or Physical damage. When you deal Water damage, you inflict Soaked X where X is your Power.

monsterAbilities.name: Water Type II
monsterAbilities.description: You take half damage from Fire and Water attacks or damage, but you take 50% more from Lightning type attacks and damage. You are immune to Soaked, can swim at twice your speed and breathe underwater.

monsterAbilities.name: Web Hunter
monsterAbilities.description: When attacking a target that is Slowed or Rooted by webs, you gain Lock-On on your basic Light and Heavy Attack.

monsterAbilities.name: Wind Body
monsterAbilities.description: Your attacks may deal Physical or Wind damage. You may Sidestep 5ft after every attack.

monsterAbilities.name: Wind Type II
monsterAbilities.description: You take half damage from Wind attacks or damage and gain +2 Evasion against ranged attacks.

monsterAbilities.name: Wings
monsterAbilities.description: You can Fly through the air as if you were moving on land and your speed is doubled while doing so.

monsterActions.name: Adapt
monsterActions.descriptions: You may shift up to 2 stat points (except Toughness). The minimum is 3 and maximum is 9.

monsterActions.name: Alchemic Barrage (Backpack)
monsterActions.descriptions: Fires a barrage of missiles, making a light attack with arcane damage against all targets in line of sight.  Has a bonus +10 to accuracy.

monsterActions.name: Alchemic Barrage II (Backpack)
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used when less than half health or if one body party is destroyed.
monsterActions.descriptions: Mark a target at the end of this creature's turn if there is no mark.  Activates again at the start of the creature's turn.  Fires a barrage of light attacks equal to the amount of party members at the marked target equal to the amount of party members and then mark another target.  Has a +10 to accuracy.  If the target is no longer a valid target, trigger the effects of Alchemic Barrage (Backpack) instead, and then mark another target.

monsterActions.name: Alchemic Flare (Body)
monsterActions.descriptions:
Creates an area filled with explosive gas, contained by the wall of Transmute Low Wall (Body).

If an area of gas already exists from a previous turn, ignite the gas into a fireball dealing heavy attack fire damage in the entire area that the gas was in.  Sure Hit.

monsterActions.name: Ancestor's Blessing
monsterActions.descriptions:
Upon being critically injured, you draw upon the ancestral strength of past leaders to empower and restore yourself.

Restores Half of your currently missing HP and grants you 2 additional AP on your next turn.

monsterActions.name: Angel's Embrace
monsterActions.descriptions:
You grant the target ally Angel’s Embrace granting a shield against the triggering attack that blocks damage equal to 2 + (2 x Toughness)

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

monsterActions.name: Arcane Fang
monsterActions.descriptions: Your bite channels internal magic. You make a Light Attack that deals Arcane damage. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already Dazed, this attack instead deals an additional 8 full pierce Arcane damage as the lingering magic intensifies.

monsterActions.name: Arcane Net
monsterActions.descriptions: You place a 20x20ft net of arcane energy at a point within range. The net is considered difficult terrain for your enemies. You may spend 0 RP to cancel the net, immediately rooting all creatures within the net’s area of effect at that time until the start of your next turn.

monsterActions.name: Astra Beams
monsterActions.descriptions: You make X separate Light attacks that deal Astra damage against the target. If your Absorb Magic trait is active, you gain the Power bonus for each of these attacks and the element changes to that of the magic absorbed.

monsterActions.name: Backstab
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Bandersnatch Swipe
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used while your HP is at 25% or lower.
monsterActions.descriptions: You swipe at the nearest enemy and toss them 30ft away in a direction of your choice. The target passes through allies for this movement, but will collide with walls. If they hit a wall, they take 1d4 true damage and are dazed until the start of your next turn.

monsterActions.name: Bestial Command
monsterActions.descriptions: The target may immediately spend their AP as if they had taken their turn.

monsterActions.name: Black Knight's Charge
monsterActions.descriptions:
You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

When you reach the target you make a Heavy attack against them. On damage, you may select a different target further than 20ft away, moving towards them and repeating this attack at no additional cost. You may only do this once.

monsterActions.name: Blink
monsterActions.descriptions: You teleport to an empty space within range. The next basic Heavy attack you make has it AP cost reduced to 0.

monsterActions.name: Blizzard
monsterActions.descriptions:
You create a blizzard in a 160ft radius centered on top of you. Any creature in the blizzard that is not immune to frost damage becomes slowed and has their vision reduced to 15ft.

 

Having a suitable heat source nearby or otherwise being protected from the cold removes the slowed effect given by this ability.

monsterActions.name: Blizzard Walker
monsterActions.descriptions: You Sidestep up to double your speed. Afterwards, you may stealth for 0 AP. Cannot be used in the same turn as Snow Assassin.

monsterActions.name: Boar Charge
monsterActions.descriptions:
You move up to 4 times your movement speed in a straight line and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals maximum heavy damage if it hits. If it misses, the target moves out of the way and you keep charging until you’ve reached your max movement or until you hit a target or object. All of your movement with this ability does not provoke attacks of opportunity. 

Requires at least 10ft of unimposed movement to start.

monsterActions.name: Boar Trample
monsterActions.descriptions:
You may move up to three times your movement in a straight line and gain Trample for this movement. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against the,. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

Cannot be used when an enemy unit is visible within 10 feet of you.

monsterActions.name: Bone Spike Shot
monsterActions.descriptions: You fire a spike from your mouth, making a Precise attack against the target. On damage, the target is pulled next to you in the most direct line possible. If the space next to you is blocked by another creature, the target is placed as closest to the original square as possible.

monsterActions.name: Bowling Roller
monsterActions.descriptions: You begin to quickly roll towards a target with little control.  You move in a straight line towards the target, immediately stopping at the first target or large object in your path and making a Heavy attack against that target.

monsterActions.name: Burrow
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you burrow yourself inside of the target. While burrowed, you shares the same space as the creature you burrowed in and move with it.

monsterActions.name: Charge
monsterActions.descriptions: You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on light or heavy melee attacks.

monsterActions.name: Claw Drill
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used after Vital Flurry has been used and has been canceled.
monsterActions.descriptions: You mark an enemy within range. On the start of your next turn, you may Sidestep towards them in a direct line if possible. If you do, you may immediately make 2 light attacks against the target upon arriving.

monsterActions.name: Cleaving Strike
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against two different targets in range.

monsterActions.name: Combine
monsterActions.requirements: Target must also have the Combine ability.
monsterActions.descriptions: Combine with a compatible target slime, adding HP and MP together. This can't go over the maximum, but if this results in a slime with maximum health, it restores 1 RP too.

monsterActions.name: Consume
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a light attack against the target. On hit, the target becomes rooted until they spend 1 AP, which removes all slimes that used this action. If the target took damage from this, the AP cost is increased to 2.

monsterActions.name: Crab Flexibility
monsterActions.descriptions: You Block or Dodge an attack. Then, you automatically Dodge or Block (whichever you didn't before) against the next attack.

monsterActions.name: Crab Grab
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until it takes at least 10 damage in one attack. Medium and smaller creatures are forced to move with the crab, but large creatures grabbed by this prevent you from moving more than 5ft away.

Cannot be used against a target already grabbed.

You may let go of a target for 0 AP. You suffer the root penalty for dodging against the target (but only against the target).

monsterActions.name: Crushing Presence
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Light attack against all enemies within range. 

Against an enemy that's overburdened, this also gains Full Pierce.

monsterActions.name: Crystal Barrier
monsterActions.requirements: May not have used Crystal Stomp your last turn.
monsterActions.descriptions: You reduce the damage you take by 5 until the start of your next turn..

monsterActions.name: Crystal Burst
monsterActions.requirements: Your absorb magic did not trigger since the end of your last turn.
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack that deals Astra damage to all enemies in range. You also take that amount of true damage and your max HP is lowered by that amount. If this reduces your mana to 0, you explode and deal an additional Sure Hit & Full Pierce heavy damage to all enemies in range, after which you die. When you die in this way, you do not drop a fiend core.

monsterActions.name: Crystal Stomp
monsterActions.descriptions: You stomp the ground and create a shockwave, making a Light attack against all enemies in range.

monsterActions.name: Cure Body
monsterActions.descriptions: You heal the target for 9 + Power x 3 HP. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.

monsterActions.name: Cure Touch
monsterActions.descriptions: You heal the target for 11 + (2 x Power)

monsterActions.name: Darkness
monsterActions.descriptions:
You conjure an area of pure darkness in a 30x30 ft area around it, centered on yourself. In the darkness, non-magical light ceases to function.

 

The darkness lasts until your next turn.

monsterActions.name: Darkness Shade
monsterActions.descriptions: If you are in a dark area, you attempt to Hide without using AP. When hiding in darkness, you may stay hidden if you are in direct Line of Sight of others. Leaving the dark area or having any source of light illuminate the area will immediately reveal you.

monsterActions.name: Death's Follower
monsterActions.requirements: Can be used when you would make an attack of opportunity.
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to twice your speed towards the target of the attack.

monsterActions.name: Defensive Curl
monsterActions.descriptions:
You folds yourself, entering a defensive stance. While in this stance, you can use the Block reaction for 0 RP. You cannot willingly end the stance and cannot make reaction attacks while on it.

 

The stance lasts until the end of the current creature’s turn.

monsterActions.name: Desync
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used after successfully dodging an attack.
monsterActions.descriptions: You teleport up to 20ft.

monsterActions.name: Detonate Self
monsterActions.descriptions: When you reach 0 HP, you will begin to explode. This explosion happens at the start of the turn of the character who triggered this effect. When it does, the Efreet may make a Heavy attack against all creatures within range.

monsterActions.name: Devastating Strike
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Devour Corpse
monsterActions.descriptions: You eat a nearby corpse, instantly devouring it and removing it from the field. You gain +2 AP and your maximum AP is increased by 2 until the end of the encounter.

monsterActions.name: Dig Deeper
monsterActions.descriptions: You deal maximum Light damage to the target. If you used this ability on your previous turn, it deals double the damage it dealt last time.

monsterActions.name: Digestion
monsterActions.descriptions: You attempt to digest all targets affected by Gluttony. Dealing 20 (type) damage with sure hit and full pierce.

monsterActions.name: Dire Claw
monsterActions.descriptions:
Your eyes flash into an aura sight temporarily and make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack deals double Heavy damage, but the damage is reduced to 1 i the target blocks.

If the target does not react to this attack, it gains Sure Hit.

monsterActions.name: Disengaging Shot
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a ranged weapon Heavy attack against an enemy in range that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Afterwards, you may sidestep up to your speed.

monsterActions.name: Dive Attack
monsterActions.descriptions:
You move up to 40ft towards a target within range and then make a Light attack against it. On damage, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for the rest of your turn and may move up to your movement speed at the end of your turn without spending AP.

 

If this attack fails to do damage,you lose your Flight ability and become Grounded until the start of its next turn.

monsterActions.name: Divine Shield
monsterActions.descriptions: You automatically use the Block action against the next attack targeting you.

monsterActions.name: Divine Smite
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack that deals Holy damage against the target. Against Demons in their Divine Release state, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

monsterActions.name: Draining Touch
monsterActions.descriptions: You touch the target and attempt to steal its strength, making a Light attack against the target. On damage, you gain a bonus to your Power for your next attack this turn equal to the target's Power. The target's Power becomes 0 until after its next attack.

monsterActions.name: Dream Ender
monsterActions.requirements: Target must be trapped by Nightmare Cage
monsterActions.descriptions: You kill the target and regain all your HP.

monsterActions.name: Dream Shift
monsterActions.descriptions:
You change your own form or the dreamscape to something that frightens or surprises the targets. All creatures within range must make a Save or become Shaken.

What a creature targeted by this sees is unique to each creature.

monsterActions.name: Drop in pot
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used as the first action in a turn, must have a grabbed creature.
monsterActions.descriptions: Drop a creature rooted by your vine grab in your pitcher. The creature becomes stunned and takes Heavy full piercing damage at the start of its turn until you die.

monsterActions.name: Empower Beast
monsterActions.descriptions: You empower a chosen animal, granting them +2 maximum AP and AP recovery until the end of the encounter.

monsterActions.name: Esoteric Art: All Out
monsterActions.descriptions: You discard your armor and shield and focus on offense. You reduce your Guard and Block to 0, but gain an additional 2 AP per turn.

monsterActions.name: Evasive Maneuver
monsterActions.descriptions: You move 5ft in any direction and do not trigger any Attacks of Opportunity from this movement.

monsterActions.name: Evasive Maneuver II
monsterActions.descriptions: You may Sidestep 5ft.

monsterActions.name: Exousiai's Presence
monsterActions.descriptions:
You raise the astra level in the zone by 1. All enemies within range that do not have enough resistance to negate this immediately suffer negative effects.

Any creatures suffering from Astra Poisoning immediately have their Astra Poisoning worsened by 1 stage.

monsterActions.name: Explode Self
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Precise attack that deals fire damage against all creatures within range. This attack deals Heavy damage instead of its normal damage.

monsterActions.name: Faewolf Flash
monsterActions.descriptions: You teleport in a brief glow of eerie light to any unoccupied spot within 40 ft. Your next Heavy attack this turn costs 0 AP.

monsterActions.name: Feast
monsterActions.descriptions:
You prepare to eat a rooted target. When the setup finishes, you make a Heavy attack that deals maximum damage. On damage, you eat the target. The target becomes Stunned inside you. At the start of each of its turns, it takes Heavy full pierce damage until you die.

 

Any attacks made from inside you gains Sure Hit, Full Pierce and deals double damage.

monsterActions.name: Fireball
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against every creature in a 15x15 ft square. On damage, a target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

monsterActions.name: Firebolt
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

monsterActions.name: Flame Breath
monsterActions.descriptions: You breathe fire in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all creatures in it. On damage, a target becomes Burning X, where X is your Power x 3.

monsterActions.name: Focus Fire
monsterActions.descriptions: You mark an enemy as the target until the start of your next turn. All Grunt level allies under your command must attack that target if they are able to do so without moving. They gain a +1 Power bonus to attacks against this target.

monsterActions.name: Focused Gaze
monsterActions.requirements: Target suffered an agility penalty due to Petrifying Gaze.
monsterActions.descriptions: The target suffers a -1 penalty to their agility. Can stack.

monsterActions.name: Frost Creation: Tower
monsterActions.descriptions:
You summon a 10ft high frosty tower within range. The tower has 45 HP, 4 guard and no reactions. Attacks against the tower always hit.

The tower acts at initiative 0, at the end of a round. When it does, it makes a single light attack using the your stats at every enemy within 20ft of it. This attack has half pierce, deals Frost damage and on damage, the enemy is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

monsterActions.name: Frosty Start
monsterActions.descriptions: Your initiative increases by 5. You may summon 1 tower described in ‘Frost Creation: Tower’ anywhere within range.

monsterActions.name: Full Petrify
monsterActions.descriptions:
The target becomes temporarily petrified until the end of the encounter.

 

A petrified creature has 0 AP and RP and can take no actions, but gains a guard bonus of +10.

 

If the basilisk is not defeated at the encounter conclusion phase, the petrification becomes permanent.

monsterActions.name: Ghoul Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You attempt to bite a target creature making a Heavy attack against them. You heal for the damage this attack deals.

monsterActions.name: Glittershards
monsterActions.descriptions: Numerous sparkling arcane crystals swarm the area and block line of sight.  Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Glittershards can only see up to 5ft into or out of Glittershards.  Glittershards lasts for up to 10 minutes and you can only have 1 Glittershards active at a time.  You can end this effect for 0 AP on your turn.

monsterActions.name: Gluttony
monsterActions.descriptions: You attempt to consume a target, making a Heavy Attack against the target.  On hit, the target is affected by Gluttony and becomes engulfed in slime.  An engulfed target becomes Weakened.  An ally can attempt to pull a consumed target from the slime with a DC20 Power Check, removing the effects of Gluttony.

monsterActions.name: Go for the Throat
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Gobbo Regeneration
monsterActions.descriptions: You heal yourself for 15+Toughness HP

monsterActions.name: Gobbo Throw Rock
monsterActions.descriptions: You deal 2 true damage to the target.

monsterActions.name: Goring Charge
monsterActions.descriptions:
You lower your head as you charge and look to crash into either the target or an obstacle barring your path. Any object that is not made of sufficiently thick metal or stone (DM Discretion) is destroyed in the charge. Any creature behind said object is immediately knocked Prone and takes Light damage.

If this attack hits a creature, you will make a Heavy attack on the target. When using more than 2 AP on this movement, you gain an additional 1 focus and 2 power on this attack. On damage if the creature has less toughness than you, they are immediately knocked Prone and Dazed.

monsterActions.name: Grab
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you and the target are both Rooted.

The target may spend 1 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted. If the target is grabbed by multiple enemies through this ability, spending the 1 AP will free it from all grabs.

monsterActions.name: Gravity Crash
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies within range.

monsterActions.name: Gravity Pull
monsterActions.descriptions: You pull every enemy within range up to 40ft.

monsterActions.name: Hallowed Ground
monsterActions.descriptions: You bless the ground in a 10ft radius around yourself. Allies in the blessed ground regain HP equal to their Toughness when they spend an RP. The blessed ground remains set in place, even when you move.

monsterActions.name: Headbutt
monsterActions.requirements: Landing a normal Light or Heavy attack
monsterActions.descriptions: On dealing damage with a melee attack, you can follow-up with a headbutt as a Light attack. On damage the target is Unbalanced.

monsterActions.name: Heat Wave
monsterActions.descriptions: All creatures within range must make a save or take Light Fire damage.

monsterActions.name: Homing Shot
monsterActions.range: Ranged Weapon Range or Thrown Weapon Range
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a heavy attack against the target  with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.

monsterActions.name: Hydra Breath
monsterActions.descriptions: You breathe in a 30ft cone, making a Light attack against all targets in it. The damage type is based on the head’s element. On damage, you apply an effect based on the head’s element. The Earth head inflicts Daze for 1 turn, the Frost head inflicts Slowed for 1 turn and the Lightning head inflicts Static X for 1 turn, where X is your Power x 3.

monsterActions.name: Hydra Constrict
monsterActions.descriptions: You and the target both become rooted. The target may spend 2 AP to break free, after which the target and you are both no longer rooted.

monsterActions.name: Impale
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes rooted until the start of your next turn.

Combo: If used after Black Knight’s Charge, this ability’s cost is reduced to 1 AP and the attack gains Full Pierce.

monsterActions.name: Improved Feint
monsterActions.descriptions: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target.

monsterActions.name: Ink Attack
monsterActions.requirements: You and the target must both be standing on Ink.
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Inky Dodge
monsterActions.requirements: You are the target of an attack.
monsterActions.descriptions: You take the Dodge action against the triggering attack, then teleport up to 40ft.

monsterActions.name: Insect Assault
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target that deals Physical(Piercing) damage.

monsterActions.name: Ixilune's Command
monsterActions.descriptions:
You move one of your Swarms up to 20ft or you may Sidestep an ally up to 20ft.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead.

monsterActions.name: Ixith Swarm
monsterActions.descriptions:
You summon a swarm of insects in a 15x15 square. Any creature except for you, a devouring swarm or a summoner contracted to you ending their turn inside of it takes Full Pierce Light damage.

You may have up to two of these swarms active at the same time.

monsterActions.name: Jumping Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You leap out from below that ground and make a Heavy attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Leading Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, all allied Wolves may move up to their movement speed closer to the target.

monsterActions.name: Leaping Strike
monsterActions.descriptions: You jump to a target within range and make a Light attack against it.

monsterActions.name: Lightning Charge
monsterActions.descriptions: You turn into a ball of lightning and Sidestep in a straight line to a square within range. You can pass through units while doing so and may make a Light attack against each unit you pass through. This attack deals Lightning damage.

monsterActions.name: Lion's Roar
monsterActions.descriptions: All enemies within range must make a Save or become Unbalanced. They also become Slowed until the end of your next turn.

monsterActions.name: Luck Surge
monsterActions.descriptions: The target must reroll their roll. Can not be used on a roll that was already rerolled.

monsterActions.name: Lucky Dodge
monsterActions.requirements: You are the target of an attack.
monsterActions.descriptions:
You may Sidestep 5ft and the attack against you automatically misses.

Roll a d20. If you roll 11 or higher, you recover 2 RP.

monsterActions.name: Lucky Hit
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If the attack hits, it is automatically a critical hit.

monsterActions.name: Lucky Lass
monsterActions.descriptions: You shoot a golden coin at an enemy, making a Light attack against the target that deals 2d10 Astra damage, but doesn’t receive bonuses from power.

monsterActions.name: Luring Pollen
monsterActions.descriptions: Any creature within range that’s more than 10ft away from the you must make a save. If they fail, they must spend AP on their next turn to move as close to you as possible. Once they are within 5ft of you, the effect ends.

monsterActions.name: Mana Razor Alpha
monsterActions.descriptions: Your melee attacks gain an additional 60ft range. They are still counted as melee attacks and do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

monsterActions.name: Maul
monsterActions.descriptions: You makes a Heavy attack against the target that deals maximum Heavy damage. This attack automatically misses if the target uses the Dodge reaction.

monsterActions.name: Missile Barrage
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack that deals Arcane damage to all enemies within range.

monsterActions.name: Mounted Charge
monsterActions.descriptions:
You may move up to twice your movement in a straight line towards a target further than 20ft away and gain Trample after moving at least 20ft. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

When you reach the target you make a Heavy attack against them

monsterActions.name: Nightmare Cage
monsterActions.descriptions:
You trap the target in a magical cage and teleport them next to you. The target becomes Stunned.

The cage can be targeted by attacks. Attacks against it cannot miss, it has 55 HP, no reactions and has a base guard of 0. When its HP reaches 0 or if your HP reaches 0, the cage is destroyed.

When the cage is destroyed, the trapped target may immediately take a turn after the current creature’s turn has ended, regardless of their initiative. They do double damage during this turn. Their initiative does not change based on this immediate turn.

monsterActions.name: Nothing
monsterActions.descriptions: Placeholder ability so site doesn't break

monsterActions.name: Oppressing Glare
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used the turn after The Blur breaks for the first time.
monsterActions.descriptions:
All enemies must make a save against your potency (10+Focus) or become stricken with irrational fear. While feared, all their attacks targeting you cost +1 AP and you gain +4 to hit against them.

This debuff lasts until they hit you or you dodge or block one of their attacks.

monsterActions.name: Perfect Shell
monsterActions.descriptions: You Block a ranged attack, as long as the accuracy roll is below your Dodge value.

monsterActions.name: Poison Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already dazed, it takes 8 full pierce Poison damage instead.

monsterActions.name: Poison Spore
monsterActions.descriptions:
You release poisonous spores in a 5ft radius around you that last until the start of your next turn. Any creature that ends their turn inside the spores takes full pierce Poison damage equal to your Power + 3.

Poison Spores from multiple mushrooms can stack.

monsterActions.name: Poisonous Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target. On damage, the target must succeed on a save or become Weakened until the end of their next turn. A character that is already weakened takes an additional 5 (Light) or 10 (Heavy) full-pierce Poison damage instead.

monsterActions.name: Poltergeist
monsterActions.descriptions: You throw an unattended object within range at a target within range, making either a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack that deals normal listed damage. You do not need to physically interact with the object to throw it.

monsterActions.name: Pounce
monsterActions.descriptions: You may move up to twice your speed towards an enemy and then make 2 AP worth of attacks against them.

monsterActions.name: Power Strike
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the enemy.

monsterActions.name: Provoke
monsterActions.descriptions: Until the start of your next turn, the target is Challenged by you.

monsterActions.name: Queen's Domain
monsterActions.descriptions:
You shape the area around you to be like that of your hive. The area within 20ft of you gains the following properties:

  • You gain Tremorsense in your hive area, becoming aware of the exact location of all creatures touching the ground.
  • Any non-flying creature except for you, a devouring swarm or a summoner contracted to you is slowed in the area. 
  • When an enemy dies while in the domain, you may choose to spawn an Ixith swarm in that location without paying the normal cost as a swarm bursts from the corpse. These do not count against your normal limits. In addition, when an enemy dies in your domain you heal for your Toughness x2

Upkeep: 1 Mana. When you pay upkeep, you may increase the radius of your hive by 10ft.

monsterActions.name: Raise Shield
monsterActions.descriptions: Your next Block action against an enemy Challenged by you costs 0 RP.

monsterActions.name: Reposition
monsterActions.descriptions: You choose a Grunt level willing ally within range. That ally may sidestep up to twice their movement speed.

monsterActions.name: Resync Bite
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used after teleporting with Desync.
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a light attack against a target within range.

monsterActions.name: Reverberant Frost
monsterActions.descriptions: All frost towers created by ‘Frost Creation: Tower’ within range immediately take action, making their single attack listed in the ability.

monsterActions.name: Rock Crunching Bite
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target. You don’t add your focus to this roll.

monsterActions.name: Self Icicle Nail
monsterActions.descriptions: You curl up into a spike shape and fly towards an enemy. You sidestep to and make a Light attack against an enemy within range.

monsterActions.name: Shards of Ice
monsterActions.descriptions: You fire a shard of ice at every enemy within range, making a Light attack against them that deals Frost damage. This attack gains full-pierce against any enemy that is slowed.

monsterActions.name: Skeletal Arm Sweep
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Light attack against the target and any enemies adjacent to it. On damage, they are knocked back 20ft.

If at least 3 arms are still alive, you may repeat this attack against a different target within range.

monsterActions.name: Skeletal Armblade Barrage
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target. This attack deals Light damage X amount of times, where X is the amount of arms still alive (Max 4). These are considered separate instances of damage, so you don’t add the damage together before subtracting the guard from it.

monsterActions.name: Skullsplitter
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Slam
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target  On damage, the target is moved 5ft away from you if the target is no more than twice your size.

monsterActions.name: Slice & Dice
monsterActions.requirements: You must have dealt damage to the target this turn.
monsterActions.descriptions: You may make two Light attacks against the target.

monsterActions.name: Slime Body II
monsterActions.descriptions: You gain Damage Reduction 100 against physical damage from the triggering attack

monsterActions.name: Sludge Blast
monsterActions.descriptions:
You fire a blast of black sludge at the enemy. You make a Light attack against the enemy, dealing Astra damage on hit.

You may spend 2 AP to make a Heavy or Precise attack instead.

monsterActions.name: SMASH YOU
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If the target has less toughness than the Ogre’s power, they become dazed.

monsterActions.name: SMASH YOU MORE
monsterActions.descriptions: After successfully “Dazing” a target with “SMASH YOU” , you make an additional Heavy Attack on the target and on unguarded hit the target is knocked Prone.

monsterActions.name: Snap Shot
monsterActions.range: Ranged Weapon Range or Thrown Weapon Range
monsterActions.descriptions: You may make a heavy attack against the target  with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.  You do not add your focus to the accuracy roll.

monsterActions.name: Snow Assassin
monsterActions.descriptions:
The frost maiden may Sidestep up to double her speed. Afterwards, she may make a Heavy attack against a target. If she was hidden from the target before moving, the target cannot react to the attack.

 

Cannot be used in the same turn as Blizzard Walker.

monsterActions.name: Spectral Touch
monsterActions.descriptions: You attempt to attack the soul of the target with a touch, making a Heavy attack against the target.

monsterActions.name: Spore Launch
monsterActions.descriptions: You fire poisonous spores towards an area. All within a 15x15ft area must make a save or take Power full pierce poison damage and become poisoned. The deathcap poison makes the target Sickened while it lasts.

monsterActions.name: Squeeze
monsterActions.descriptions: The target must make a Save or take Heavy damage.

monsterActions.name: Static Field
monsterActions.descriptions:
You creater a field of lightning around yourself. Any creature that ends its turn within 5ft of you gains Static X, where X is your power x 2.

The range of the field is increased to 10ft during a storm.

monsterActions.name: Stone Form
monsterActions.descriptions:
You turn yourself to hardened stone, gaining a +10 guard bonus but becoming unable to take any actions. All attacks made against you automatically hit, but cannot crit. You may cancel this effect at the start of your turn.

If used while flying, you drop down to the ground without taking falling damage. Any creature within 5ft of where you land may spend 1 RP or else they take Heavy damage.

monsterActions.name: Stratagem: Lightning
monsterActions.range: All allies in sight, including yourself.
monsterActions.descriptions: All allied units (including yourself) gain +1 to initiative and may immediately move up to their speed.

monsterActions.name: Summon Beast
monsterActions.descriptions: You summon a Wolf, Boar, Giant Spider or Cheetah (Chosen randomly). This creature is friendly to you and you may direct its actions in combat. It acts at initiative 0. It lasts until the end of the encounter, or until either your or its HP reaches 0 or lower, after which it immediately disappears.

monsterActions.name: Sweep
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against all enemies in range. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft.

monsterActions.name: Sweeping Opportunity
monsterActions.requirements: You hit an enemy with an Attack of Opportunity.
monsterActions.descriptions: The target falls prone.

monsterActions.name: Swooping Strike
monsterActions.descriptions: You may Sidestep up to twice your speed. At any point during this movement, you may make a Light attack.

monsterActions.name: Swooping Strike II
monsterActions.descriptions: You may Sidestep up to twice your speed. At any point during this movement, you may make a Heavy attack.

monsterActions.name: Tail Spikes
monsterActions.descriptions: You firee a hail of spikes at a 15x15 ft area, making a Light attack against all enemies within the area. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. If the target is already Dazed, they instead take 5 poison damage.

monsterActions.name: Tail Swipe
monsterActions.descriptions: You spin around your axis and attack every creature within 10ft of you with a Light attack. On damage, a target is pushed back 15ft.

monsterActions.name: Terrifying Roar
monsterActions.descriptions: All creatures that can hear the roar of the firewyrm must make a save or become Shaken. This effect lasts until the end of combat, or until the target uses 3 AP to remove the effect from themselves.

monsterActions.name: Threatening Aura
monsterActions.descriptions: Until the start of your next turn, all enemies in your melee range are considered Challenged by you.

monsterActions.name: Three Headed Assault
monsterActions.descriptions: You and all other heads make a Light attack against the target. All heads, except for you, that made an attack regain 1 less AP on their turn.

monsterActions.name: Topple Prey
monsterActions.descriptions: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target falls Prone.

monsterActions.name: Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)
monsterActions.descriptions: Fires a transmutation cannon, unleashing a blast of energy that deals light attack damage.  Regardless of if the attack hits or not, the target must make a save against DC 15 or be knocked back 30 feet.  If the target hits a wall or another creature, both creatures take heavy attack damage.

monsterActions.name: Transmute Low Wall (Body)
monsterActions.descriptions: Creates a 3ft high wall that counts as difficult terrain.  The wall extends up to 120 feet and lasts for 10 minutes, or until Alchemic Flare or Transmute Low Wall are used, causing the wall to crumble.

monsterActions.name: Ultimate Lifeform
monsterActions.descriptions: You remove all stacks of one status effect from yourself.

monsterActions.name: Vine Grab
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used after dealing damage with a melee attack.
monsterActions.descriptions:
Your vine wraps around the target, rooting it. The vine can be destroyed by attacking it. It has 14 HP and takes double damage from fire damage and Slashing attacks. It cannot make reactions, has 0 guard and attacks against it always hit.

 

A creature can be grabbed by multiple vines at the same time.

monsterActions.name: Vital Flurry
monsterActions.requirements: Can only be used once. Can only be used after your HP reaches 50%.
monsterActions.descriptions:
You target an enemy within range and begin to rapidly slash at them. Every time you are attacked by anyone, you may make a light attack against the target of this ability. On damage, you recover 4 HP.

Lasts until you lose The Blur.

monsterActions.name: Web Spray
monsterActions.descriptions:
You make a Light attack against the target that deals no damage, but covers the target in webs. On hit, the target becomes rooted.This effect lasts until the target or an ally spends 4 AP to remove the webbing.

 

If a creature rooted by this ability takes fire damage, the effect also disappears as the webs burn away.

monsterActions.name: Webbing
monsterActions.descriptions:
You cover a 30x30ft square surface in webs. All creatures in the webbed area become slowed. The webs last until this ability is used again, or until the webs take fire damage on which they are immediately destroyed. Any creature touching the webbing when it is lit on fire becomes Burning 10.

 

Any creature that ends their turn in the webbed area becomes rooted. This lasts until they or an ally spends 4 AP to free themselves. After a unit is freed from the webs, they cannot become rooted by the same web until the end of their next turn. If the webbing is destroyed, a rooted creature is also immediately freed.

monsterActions.name: Weight of the World
monsterActions.descriptions:
Every enemy in range suffers +1 Burden until the end of the encounter. This can stack.

You immediately kill all grunts and summons.

monsterActions.name: Wind Blast
monsterActions.descriptions: You fire a large gust of wind at a 30x30 feet square within range. You make a Heavy attack that deals Wind damage against all targets within the area. On damage, the target is blown away to the nearest edge of the square and knocked Prone.

monsterActions.name: Zero Impact Generator (Left Arm)
monsterActions.descriptions: Generates a shield with 35 HP that blocks damage to other body parts except the left arm.

rulebook.content:
Introduction

Lyrian Chronicles is a game for ttrpg players and by ttrpg players.  After playing through several systems we had decided to make one that solves a lot of the issues that we had with them.  We drew inspiration from the best parts of each system, while trying to fix the problems that we saw in them.  We wanted to bring an experience that allows each player to create and play the character that they want, while adding technical skill and decision making into combat.  Characters are not just the sum of their combat abilities, they create bonds, and spend their free time pursuing their hobbies and dreams and we wanted to reflect both aspects of heroes.

Since we mostly play these games online, we wanted to develop the system with online players in mind—built from the ground up for the online audience while still trying to make the game accessible for players in person.  These games had always had a table and pen focus, but we wanted to create something that we would use.

Taking advantage of our online focus, we wanted to bring Tabletop Games As A Service, constant and frequent updates with balance changes.  By ditching “dead trees” as our medium we will be able to be more agile in responding to balance issues and rules errors.  Both members of our design team have experience in commercial Live Design.

We hope you enjoy the game.

- Angel's Sword Studios

 

General Rules:

  • Unless stated otherwise, always round down.
  • Unless stated otherwise, apply flat effects before doubling or halving.
  • Unless stated otherwise, effects from the same source or with the same name do not stack.
    • A buff or debuff that does not have a specific name also does not stack with a buff/debuff that doesn't have a specific name and gives the same bonus. For example, a +1 Power bonus does not stack with other things that give a +1 Power bonus.

 

Character Creation

Lyrian Chronicles does not use a level system and instead uses “power level” which is equal to the total experience points a character has.  To create a character follow these steps.

 

1. Choose a race

Races can have several abilities and may have sub-races. Refer to the specific race page. Races always grant Proficiencies, Attributes and Skills and the abilities listed.

If you are playing a Demon, then you can choose one of the clans listed at the bottom of the page. Each of the clans has a specific role in Demon society and they gain abilities that reflect that.

If you are playing a Chimera, Fae or Youkai then you can pick a subrace in addition to a primary race. Each subrace belongs to a primary race and you can only pick a subrace that matches your primary race. You gain all listed benefits from your chosen subrace.

 

2. Choose Main Stats and Sub Stats

In Lyrian Chronicles, there are main stats and sub stats.  Main stats primarily affect combat and sub stats primarily affect out of combat, however sub stats can be called for in combat usages.  You pick your main and sub stats according to the set array listed in brackets.

The numbers in these set arrays can be assigned to the stats in any order, but all values must be used and can only be used an equal amount of time as the time they appear in the array. For example:

Power: 4

Focus: 3

Agility: 5

Toughness: 4

Is a valid array.

 

Main Stats (5, 4, 4, 3)

Power:  Increases the damage dealt by attacks and increases your max mana.

Focus: Increases the accuracy of your attacks and increases the difficulty of saves against your effects.

Agility: Increases your Evasion, RP and boosts your initiative.

Toughness: Increases your HP, saves bonus and your guard value.

 

Sub Stats (5, 4, 3, 2, 1)

Fitness: Fitness is your physical fitness.  It affects the main skills Athletics and Riding.

Cunning: Cunning is your ability to use your wits on the fly to solve problems through indirect approaches and deception.  It affects the main skills Deception, Roguecraft and Stealth.

Reason: Reason is your intelligence and brainpower.  While it doesn’t immediately confer you practical experience, it gives you vast knowledge.  It affects many main skills:  Artifice, Appraise, Expert Knowledge, Flight, History, Linguistics, Magic, Medicine, Religion.

Awareness: Awareness is your perception, wisdom and presence of mind.  It affects the main skills: Animal Husbandry, Insight, Perception, Survival.

Presence: Presence affects the strength of your personality and ability to captivate and persuade others.  It affects the main skills: Art, Intimidation, Negotiation.

 

Derived Stats

Spirit Core: Your spirit core value is equal to your total EXP spent. It starts at 0.

HP: Your starting HP is equal to 20 + (Toughness x 10). 

Mana: Your starting mana is 6 + Power. Mana is required to use more powerful abilities.

RP: Your max RP is 2 + Agility.

Guard: Your starting guard is equal to (Equipment Value) + Toughness. Guard reduces the damage you take by 1 for every point, but cannot reduce damage below 1.

Initiative: Your initiative is equal to your Agility. Higher initiative means you act earlier in combat.

Evasion: Is equal to 7 + Agility. The higher your Evasion, the harder it will be for an enemy to hit you.

Potency: Your potency is equal to 11 + Focus. Your potency determines the DC for certain abilities.

Save bonus: Is equal to your toughness. You will need to make saves to resist certain effects.

Speed: Unless otherwise noted, your base speed is 20.

 

3. Breakthroughs

Each character starts with 300 exp that can only be used on breakthroughs. This EXP is not added to your spirit core and any exp not spent during this time is removed after the character creation process.

 

4. Choose Classes

Players start with 1000 EXP that must be spent on classes as well as 3 Interlude Points.  You can choose any combination of classes and abilities within the classes.  Any interlude points you do not use on unlocking classes you can instead use on interlude actions.

A new class costs 1 interlude point and 100 EXP per tier.  Each class contains key abilities and 7 more abilities that can be obtained with 100 EXP, but must be purchased in order.  When all of a class’ abilities are purchased, the class is considered Mastered.

 

5. Choose Skills

Players start with 10 skill points that can be distributed at their choice.  Main skills and their sub stat affiliations are as follows:

  • Fitness
    • Athletics
    • Riding
  • Cunning
    • Deception
    • Roguecraft
    • Stealth
  • Reason
    • Artifice
    • Appraise
    • Common Knowledge
    • Flight
    • History
    • Linguistics
    • Magic
    • Medicine
    • Religion
  • Awareness
    • Animal Husbandry
    • Insight
    • Perception
    • Survival
  • Presence
    • Art
    • Intimidation
    • Negotiation

Expertise: Instead of choosing a main skill, a player may instead opt to expertise.  The player chooses a more specific skill within the main skills (ex:  Survival, Forests;  Religion, Cult of The Black Hand of Jakka).  Any skill point added as expertise grants 2 points instead of 1.

Skill check use the following formula, for reference:

d20 + (Affiliated Sub Stat) + (Main Skill) + (Expertise)

Only 1 (the highest) expertise applies per roll.

6. Buy Equipment

Each character starts with 3000 Clim they can spend on basic equipment and items.

 

7. Progression 

When you get EXP, it is added to your EXP count. Any EXP you spend is added to your Spirit Core. You may spend your EXP to buy Breakthroughs, Classes or Abilities. 

 

Classes, Abilities & Breakthroughs

Classes

Classes are what give characters most of their power. They symbolize the training and effort a character has put into mastering a certain set of abilities. Every class has the key abilities as well as 7 levels of normal abilities that a character can unlock.

Once all abilities are learned, a class is considered mastered.

You can check all the classes here.

 

Tiers & Requirements

Classes are separated into tiers, starting with the base classes at tier 1 and each higher tier becoming more powerful but having certain requirements.

 

Unlocking new classes

To unlock a new class, you must choose the Unlock Class option during an interlude phase and spend both an Interlude Point and EXP to unlock a class of which you meet the requirements (if any). The EXP required is equal to the tier of the class x 100. Meaning a tier 1 class takes 100 EXP in addition to the Interlude Point, but a tier 2 class would take 200 EXP + the Interlude Point.

When you unlock a class, you immediately learn the key abilities.

This period during the interlude phase represents your training to learn these new abilities. As such, the GM may rule that certain classes, especially the more advanced ones, require you to learn from a person that has knowledge in the class you are attempting to unlock. If no such person exists or they are unwilling to teach you, the GM can rule that you cannot attempt to unlock that class.

 

Unlocking more abilities

You may spend 100 EXP in a class that is not yet maxed to learn the next ability in that class. The second, fourth and sixth abilities are instead passive increases to your stats or skills. These still require the same to unlock.

Since it’s possible to save EXP, you can unlock new abilities outside of an Interlude phase. However this can only be done when taking a rest.

If there is a situation in which you would get a duplicate ability by spending EXP in a class, the EXP spent is refunded. This applies even when learning a new class, though unlocking the class would still require an Interlude Point as normal. If there is a situation where the abilities don't exactly match, but you still have everything else the ability has to give, then you get a half exp refund.

There might be a case where an ability literally cannot be used by a character. In such a case, the ability is also refunded. Because this is extremely rare, these will be listed below:

  • Ararchne/Centaur getting Living Lightning.

 

Abilities

Abilities are spells, techniques or special skills that characters can use to gain an advantage in both combat and non-combat situations. 

In general, every ability that targets an ally or enemy requires you to have line of sight to that target unless it says otherwise. Things that block Line of Sight such as smokes, glittershards or even a wall in the way means you cannot target it.

Once per round limitation

Every ability, unless it has the Rapid keyword or is a basic action (such as movement, basic light atack etc), can only be used once per round. This means that once you use an ability, you can’t use that same ability again until it becomes your turn again. Upgraded abilities count as the same ability.  For example casting Fireball 2 expends the usage of Fireball.

 

Potency

The potency of an ability reflects how hard it is to avoid its effect. It’s equal to 11+The caster’s Focus.

When resisting an effect, the target rolls a save. A save is 2d10+Toughness.

 

Buffs, Debuffs and Conditions

Buffs, Debuff and Conditions are lasting effects applied by abilities, items, traps etc.

Any effects with the same name do not stack, only apply the highest value. Effects with a different number are still considered the same effect. For example, a +2 Power increase is considered the same effect as +1 Power increase and only the +2 would take effect.

 

Elemental Mastery

Some classes or abilities give a character mastery of an element, like for example a mage’s Arcane Mastery.

Mastery of an element allows a character to use it with channeling weapons. In addition, this mastery lets them create minor magical effects relating to the element. For arcane, this could be minor stuff like making tiny objects levitate, creating visual and auditory effects. These tricks do not do damage and the effects should never be big enough to affect something in combat.

 

Explaining an example ability

Name: Magic Missile

Cost: 1 mana, 1 AP

Keywords: Lock On, Rapid

Range: 60ft

Requirement: None

Description:

You fire a highly accurate blast of arcane energy at the target, dealing light arcane damage on hit.

 

Name: Simply the name of the ability. Can easily be reflavored by the player if desired.

Cost: What the ability costs to use in terms of resources. Most abilities will cost either AP or RP to use and some may use mana.

Keywords: Any keywords that apply to the ability. A list of keywords can be found here.

Range: The range of ability as well as other things relating to targeting, such as potential radius or number of targets hit by it.

Requirement: The requirement to use this ability (if any).

Description: Gives a basic description of what happens, then explains what that translates to in gameplay. In the example, the first part is “You fire a highly accurate blast of arcane energy at the target”. In most circumstances, a player should be free to reflavor this as they wish.

 

Secret Arts

Secret arts are powerful abilities that can change the tide of battle. However, their strong power makes them equally as exhausting. A player may only use one Secret Art ability per encounter regardless of how many Secret Arts they know. Unless mentioned otherwise, Secret Arts cannot be used outside of an encounter.

 

Breakthroughs

In Angel’s Sword TTRPG, your character has the potential to achieve amazing things, and a "Breakthrough" represents a pivotal moment in their story where they unlock new abilities or skills. Whether it's from training with a master, unlocking a hidden power, or experiencing a transformative event, your character's breakthroughs are special factors that enable them to reach new heights.

Breakthroughs are purchased similarly to class skills but they do not have a class tree. The cost listed in a breakthrough is how much experience it costs to purchase. It is possible for Breakthroughs to increase in level, and many Breakthroughs have requirements before they can be selected.  Unlike learning a class, Breakthroughs do not cost an interlude point.  You can only take each Breakthrough once unless it is specified in the description.

You can find a list of Breakthroughs here.

 

Skills

How To Use Skills

The GM can initiate immediate skill challenges and the player may also request to initiate one from the GM.  The task could be something like jumping up onto a roof, understanding ancient texts or deciphering a spell that will reach the party within 6 seconds.  The GM chooses a target number based on difficulty.  The GM Should choose the exact challenge rating that they feel.   Provided is a list of ranks:

10 = Initiate Task,  Something a person trained in the basics might be able to achieve on average.
15 = Professional Task, Something a professional or career person within the field might be able to achieve on average.
20 = Expert Task, Something an expert with years of training within the field might be able to achieve on average.
25 = Specialist Task, Something a person devoted to a field might be able to achieve on average.
30 = Master Task, Something a person that devoted their life’s work to a field might be able to achieve on average.

Once the challenge rating has been set, the player uses the skill according to the following formula:

d20 + (Affiliated Sub Stat) + (Main Skill) + (Expertise)

Only 1 (the highest) expertise applies per roll.

If the roll meets or exceeds the challenge rating then the challenge is cleared.

 

How to use Skills (Pressured Task Challenge)

The GM can initiate a task challenge when a difficult and time intensive task must be completed quickly.  The task could be something like turning a rusty valve, a party working together to decipher a puzzle or determining the weakpoint of an enemy airship.  The GM gives the task “Challenge HP”.

Players then are allowed to use their relevant skills according to the following formula:

d20 + (Affiliated Sub Stat) + (Main Skill) + (Expertise)

The total is subtracted from the Challenge HP.   When the Challenge HP reaches zero then the task is cleared.  

The task is also cleared if any threats are cleared and the party has unlimited time to perform the task.  In this case the GM chooses an amount of time to advance in game for the task to clear.

 

Skill cap:

The maximum amount of skill points you can put into a skill is 15 points. The maximum expertise points you can put into an expertise is 15 points (for a +15 bonus).

When you reach skybound tier (5k spirit core), this limit is increased by another 5 points.

At 10k spirit core, this limit is removed.

Any bonuses to skills, such as through presence concealment, items etc are not affected by this cap.

Main Skills List
Fitness

Athletics:  This skill describes using strength to perform tasks.  It can be used to push, pull, lift and carry.  Examples of expertise skills:  Swimming, Jumping, Climbing, Basketball

Riding: This skill describes your ability to mount a creature or vehicle and maintain control of it in tough conditions.  Examples of expertise skills:  Horses, Raptors, Giant Rabbits.

 

Cunning

Deception: This skill describes your ability to deceive others.  Examples of expertise skills:  Distraction, Lying. 

Roguecraft:  This skill describes your ability to take subterfuge actions.  Things like picking locks, rigging traps etc.  Examples of expertise skills:  Lockpicking, Jury Rigging, Traps.

Stealth: This skill describes your ability to prevent yourself and your actions from being perceived by others.  Examples of expertise skills:  Forests, Urban, Snow.

 

Reason

Artifice: This skill describes the usages of magic devices called “Artifices”.  These devices consume magical fuel in order to operate.  This encompasses the knowledge of the general use, function and construction of Artifice technology. Can not be used to craft them. Examples of expertise skill: Craftsmanship, Swords, Guns, Manufacturers.

Appraise: This skill represents your ability to evaluate the quality, authenticity, and value of items, from common goods to rare artifacts. It can be used to detect forgeries, negotiate fair prices, or recognize historically significant objects. Examples of expertise skills: Gemstone Grading, Antique Weapons, Merchant Guild Valuations, Forgery Detection.

Common Knowledge: This skill describes your ability to recall only commonly known knowledge about subjects.  Expertise in this skill becomes Expert Knowledge which gives you understanding beyond that of the layman.  Examples of expertise skills:  Airships, Forests, Physics, Chemistry

Linguistics: This skill describes your ability to comprehend languages you know and deciphering ones you don't know. Examples of expertise skills: Cyphers

Flight:  This skill describes your knowledge of flying devices and ability to utilize them.  Examples of expertise skills:  Cruiser-Class Airships, Aerial Staves, Airship Shields, Airship Engines, Airship Navigation, Leyline Cartography.

History:  This skill describes your knowledge and understanding of history.  It can be used as a tactical and strategic skill and can also be used for knowing about the past.  Examples of expertise skills:  Westrian History, Northi Noble Houses, Royal Ettiquette, Battlefield Command.

Magic: This skill describes your knowledge of arcane phenomena.  It can be used to understand spells, disable certain spells and identify them.  Examples of expertise skills:  Dispel, Magic Hacking, Fire Magic, Magic Traps.

Medicine: This skill describes your ability to render medical aid and general biology knowledge.  Examples of expertise skills:  Natural Medicines, Biology:  Humans.

Religion: This skill describes your understanding of faith-based phenomena.  It can be used to understand faith spells but can also be used for knowledges on specific religions.  Examples of expertise skills:  Faith Spell Identification, Church of Westria.

 

Awareness

Animal Husbandry: This skill describes your ability to form bonds with animals.  This can assist with riding, herding, keeping pets and calming animals.  Examples of expertise: Horses, Hawks, Raptors.

Insight: This skill describes your ability to perceive a specific object or person, including picking up on subtle details.  Examples of expertise: Body Language, Handwriting.

Perception: This skill describes your ability to perceive what is around you, even when not paying full attention.  Examples of expertise:  Urban, Forest, Snow, Hearing.

Survival: This skill describes your ability to prepare against hostile environments.  Survival can help you create and find shelter and find food.  Examples of expertise:  Improvised Cooking, Wayfinding, Forest Survival, Fishing.

 

Presence

Art: This skill describes your ability to create and perform art.  Examples of expertise:  Cartography, Memory Drawing, Singing, Dancing.

Intimidation:  This skill describes your ability to use fear to gain an upper hand in a social situation.  Examples of expertise:  Mercantile, Nobility, Commonfolk.

Negotiation:  This skill describes your ability to sway sentiment in your favor.  It describes your ability to socially function.  Examples of expertise:  Mercantile, Nobility, Commonfolk. 

 

Artisan Skills:

Artisan skills are skills used by gathering and crafting classes. These cannot be selected normally by any class or feature that lets you pick skills, unless the name of such skill is explicitly mentioned.

Cap:

These skills have a cap on how many skill points you can put into one. This limit is 10 normal skill points and 10 expertise points (for a +10 expertise bonus) in an expertise points. You may have 10 expertise points in multiple different expertise's if you wish, though you'd only be able to apply 1 expertise bonus per craft.

Expertise:

Unlike normal skills, artisan skills have a stricter restriction on what they can pick for their expertises.

Blacksmith: Each weapon group can be an expertise. If you choose a weapon group to expertise, it applies to both One-handed and Two-handed variants. You can also pick tool expertise, letting you expertise in every type of tool you can make. In addition, there is Artisan Weapon expertise which works on all artisan weapons.

Alchemist: Flasks, Elixirs, Potions, Poisons and Salves are the possible expertise's.

Farmer: Food, Alchemy units and Herbs are the possible expertise's.

Carpenter: Bows, crossbows, staves, wands, slings whips and buildings are the possible expertises.

Armorsmithing: Clothing, Light Armor, Medium Armor, Heavy armor, Shields are the possible expertises.

Artificer: Pistol, Shotgun, Musket, Sniper Rifle, Airships, Weapon Artifice, Assist Artifice, Basic Artifice are the possible expertises. Weapon Artifice expertises applies to both weapons and weapon attachments.

Gathering Cap and Expertise

Gathering skills have a max limit of 15 skill points, but they have no possible expertises.

Skill Encounters

Not all of the trials that the players will be faced with can be solved with the sword.  The world of Lyr also favors the cunning and the sharp witted with battles of the mind and of survival.  In this section you will find rules that will test your mettle outside of combat.

 

Initiative

Like in combat encounters, turn order is determined by initiative.  At the start of the encounter, before anything else is done, every participant’s initiative is ranked from high to low.  The character or event with the highest initiative gets to act first.

 

Surprise

Like in combat encounters, when one or more characters are unaware of the others, a surprise round occurs.  This generally only occurs when one side of a conflict is trying to be stealthy.  The GM rules on who exactly is surprised and who isn't.

All characters who are not surprised gain a +1 to their initiative.  In addition, the character that triggers the event gets placed at the top of the initiative order.

 

First Shot

There may be times when both parties are aware and wary of each other, but the encounter hasn’t started yet. In such a standoff, there is no surprise round if a person makes a move, but that character does automatically get placed at the top of the initiative order.

 

Encounter Start Abilities

After the initiative order has been determined characters may use Encounter Start abilities. Each character can only use one Encounter Start ability and Encounter Start abilities may only be used at this point of the encounter. If multiple characters have Encounter Start abilities that conflict with each other, the character with the highest initiative goes first.

 

Individual Turns

What happens and is possible when it’s your turn.

On their turn, a character can take a single action during a Skill Encounter. 

In addition to character turns, there can also be Event Turns which represent the different elements of the encounter that need to be cleared.  Various effects can occur on Event Turns depending on the Event.

 

Events

During Skill Encounters, players will face a new type of conflict in the form of Events.  Events could represent anything from:  an angry shopkeeper, a cave collapsing on the party or even a blinding snowstorm.

Events have HP just like characters, but their HP can only be reduced through event specific skills or skill encounter abilities.

Players can use the ability, “Skill Check” against events.  If the Skill Check meets or exceeds the Event’s DC (determined by the GM) then the event takes a single point of damage (unless specified otherwise by an ability).
